meanings_summary.en: change one's mind constantly; blow hot and cold; capricious; play fast and loose with tricks
meanings_summary.es: cambiar de opinión constantemente; ser veleta o veleidoso; engañar con triquiñuelas superficiales

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Offering three acorns in the morning (朝三) and four at evening dusk (暮四) duped the monkeys and became a proverb for shifting capriciously (朝三暮四).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Ofrecer tres bellotas por la mañana (朝三) y cuatro al crepúsculo (暮四) engañó a los monos y dio origen al modismo de la veleidad (朝三暮四).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originating in the Daoist classic 《庄子·齐物论》, the keeper offered monkeys 3 acorns in the morning and 4 at night; when they raged, he offered 4 in the morning and 3 at night, pacifying them. Originally it illustrated the philosophical illusion of subjective gain and loss (两行), but over centuries shifted into condemning fickle inconstancy in human behavior.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High, high, falling, falling: 'zhāo sān mù sì' (55-55-51-51). Articulate the first two syllables with level high pitch, followed by two crisp descending strikes.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 朝三暮四 specifically characterizes inconstancy of will, frequently flipping decisions, or manipulating terms to deceive.

contrasts.compared_word: 朝三暮四 vs. 见异思迁
contrasts.analysis: 朝三暮四 emphasizes vacillating inconstancy of decisions and whims, whereas 见异思迁 emphasizes abandoning one's current post or partner immediately upon seeing something more attractive.

contrasts.compared_word: 朝三暮四 vs. 朝秦暮楚
contrasts.analysis: 朝三暮四 highlights behavioral or strategic inconsistency, whereas 朝秦暮楚 specifically highlights opportunistic disloyalty in shifting political or personal allegiances.

contrasts.compared_word: 朝三暮四 vs. 出尔反尔
contrasts.analysis: 朝三暮四 reflects an internal fickle disposition, while 出尔反尔 refers directly to speaking self-contradictory words and breaking promises.

Has mouth radical 口 on the left instead of standalone 朝
Has only two horizontal strokes
Has cloth radical 巾 at the bottom instead of 日

senses.definition_en: (modern sense) to frequently change one's mind, plans, or loyalty; capricious and unreliable
senses.definition_es: (sentido moderno) cambiar de opinión, planes o fidelidad a cada instante; ser veleidoso o inconstante
senses.example_phrase: 作风朝三暮四 (fickle and erratic style)

senses.definition_en: (classical Zhuangzi sense) to deceive others through superficial alterations of form without changing the underlying substance
senses.definition_es: (sentido clásico) engañar a otros alterando la apariencia sin modificar la realidad sustancial
senses.example_phrase: 弄虚作假 (play deceitful tricks)

example_sentences.hanzi: 职场规划最忌讳的就是朝三暮四，只有锚定长远目标并深耕细作，才能在专业领域有所建树。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhíchǎng guīhuà zuì jìhuì de jiùshì zhāosān-mùsì, zhǐyǒu máodìng chángyuǎn mùbiāo bìng shēngēng-xìzuò, cáinéng zài zhuānyè lǐngyù yǒusuǒ-jiànshù.
example_sentences.en: What career planning should avoid most is blowing hot and cold; only by anchoring long-term goals and cultivating deeply can one achieve greatness.
example_sentences.es: Lo que más debe evitarse en la carrera profesional es la veleidad; solo fijando metas a largo plazo y perseverando con paciencia se cosecharán logros señeros.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在《庄子·齐物论》的原初寓言中，老人以朝三暮四戏弄群猴，深刻阐明了事物在本质上并无实质得失的哲理。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài 《Zhuāngzǐ · Qíwùlùn》 de yuánchū yùyán zhōng, lǎorén yǐ zhāosān-mùsì xìnòng qúnhóu, shēnkè chǎnmíng le shìwù zài běnzhì shàng bìng wú shízhì déshī de zhélǐ.
example_sentences.en: In the original fable from Zhuangzi, the elder tricked monkeys with 'three in morning, four at dusk', elucidating that gains and losses are fundamentally relative.
example_sentences.es: En la fábula primigenia de Zhuangzi, el anciano burló a los monos cambiando el orden de la comida, revelando que las ganancias y pérdidas son solo apariencias relativas.

change one's mind upon seeing something new; fickle

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram of the bright morning sun 杲 rising amid tall grass while the pale moon 月 fades away.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The radiant dawn sun rises through morning dew while the pale crescent moon (月) departs into dawn (朝).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El sol del alba despide sus primeros rayos entre el rocío mientras la luna menguante (月) se retira al amanecer (朝).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram of three stacked horizontal counting tallies, symbolizing the triad of Heaven, Earth, and Humanity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Three level tallies laid parallel in ancient arithmetic count out the number three (三).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Tres varillas horizontales apiladas en el cómputo aritmético arcaico marcan el número tres (三).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 莫 (mò, sun sinking in tall grass)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram of the solar orb 日 sinking into thick marsh grass 莫 at nightfall.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The red setting sun (日) sinks low beneath dark marsh weeds (莫) as dusk descends (暮).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El sol poniente (日) se sumerge al fin bajo la maleza del pantano (莫) anunciando el anochecer (暮).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram representing exhalations of breath dispersing into the four cardinal quadrants within an enclosure.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Breaths of air divide symmetrically into four compass directions within the window frame (四).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El aliento se divide con simetría hacia los cuatro puntos cardinales tras el ventanal (四).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 很多人在浮躁的世风中迷失了自我，今天渴望当作家，明天又向往从商，在朝三暮四的犹豫摇摆中白白虚掷了青春年华。唯有静下心来认清真正的内心热爱，耐得住寂寞深耕细作，才能收获丰硕的生命果实。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Hěnduō rén zài fúzào de shìfēng zhōng míshī le zìwǒ, jīntiān kěwàng dāng zuòjiā, míngtiān yòu xiàngwǎng cóngshāng, zài zhāosān-mùsì de yóuyù yáobǎi zhōng báibái xūzhì le qīngchūn niánhuá. Wéiyǒu jìngxià xīn lái rènqīng zhēnzhèng de nèixīn rè'ài, nàidezhù jìmò shēngēng-xìzuò, cáinéng shōuhuò fēngshuò de shēngmìng guǒshí.
extended_reading_passages.en: Many lose themselves in restless social trends, longing to be authors today and entrepreneurs tomorrow, squandering youth in capricious vacillation. Only by quieting the mind to discern genuine passion and enduring quiet labor can life's fruits be harvested.
extended_reading_passages.es: Muchos se pierden en el torbellino de la frivolidad, deseando hoy ser escritores y mañana negociantes, malgastando sus mejores años en veleidades estériles. Solo serenando el ánimo para abrazar una auténtica vocación y trabajando con constancia se recogen frutos colmados.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 回溯中国哲学史，《庄子》中的“朝三暮四”本意在阐明生死齐一、万物玄同的道家智慧，告诫世人切莫被表象的得失所蒙蔽。然而历经千年演变，这一成语在现代语境中已完全转化为对反复无常之举的道德针砭。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Huísù Zhōngguó zhéxuéshǐ, 《Zhuāngzǐ》 zhōng de 'zhāosān-mùsì' běnyì zài chǎnmíng shēngsǐ-qíyī, wànwù-xuántóng de Dàojiā zhìhuì, gàojiè shìrén qièmò bèi biǎoxiàng de déshī suǒ méngbì. Rán'ér lìjīng qiānnián yǎnbiàn, zhè yì chéngyǔ zài xiàndài yǔjìng zhōng yǐ wánquán zhuǎnhuà wéi duì fǎnfù-wúcháng zhī jǔ de dàodé zhēnbiān.
extended_reading_passages.en: Tracing Chinese philosophy, Zhuangzi's 'Zhao San Mu Si' originally elucidated Daoist wisdom on the equality of things, warning against illusion. Through millennia of evolution, this idiom has completely transformed into a moral rebuke of capricious fickle behavior.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la filosofía china, la fábula de Zhuangzi ilustraba la relatividad de ganancias y pérdidas exhortando a no engañarse por las apariencias. Sin embargo, tras siglos de evolución lingüística, el modismo censura hoy la inconstancia de ánimo y la falta de palabra.

meanings_summary.en: vocabulary; lexicon; collective words of a language or specialist domain
meanings_summary.es: vocabulario; léxico; caudal de palabras de un idioma o disciplina

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When individual spoken words (词) flow like streams to converge into a collective reservoir (汇), they form a language's vocabulary (词汇).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando las palabras dichas (词) confluyen como arroyos en un caudal común (汇), integran el caudal de vocabulario (词汇).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 词 originally denoted poetic verses set to musical tunes in the Song Dynasty (宋词). Paired with 汇 (confluence of waters), 词汇 conceptualizes a language's vocabulary as an oceanic convergence of centuries of cultural wisdom and communicative innovation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'cí huì' (35-51). Lift cleanly on 'cí', then drop with firm cadence on 'huì'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 词汇 refers to the collective aggregate lexical inventory of a language or speaker, rather than an isolated word.

contrasts.analysis: 词汇 is a collective noun designating the whole lexicon or lexical system (词汇丰富), whereas 词语 refers to discrete, individual vocabulary items or words (这个词语的意思).
词汇 is abstract and systemic, while 单词 specifically refers to a single individual word, most frequently used when learning foreign vocabulary (背英语单词).
词汇 is the general lexicon, while 术语 refers specifically to standardized professional technical terms in science and law.

senses.definition_en: the total body of words employed in a particular language, literary style, individual's usage, or specialized field
senses.definition_es: conjunto total de palabras que integran un idioma, el repertorio de un autor o un campo científico
senses.example_phrase: 丰富词汇量 (enrich vocabulary size)

example_sentences.hanzi: 成语是汉语词汇宝库中极富表现力的一部分，短短四个字往往蕴含着深邃的历史文化意蕴。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chéngyǔ shì Hànyǔ cíhuì bǎokù zhōng jí fù biǎoxiànlì de yíbùfen, duǎnduǎn sì gè zì wǎngwǎng yùnhán zhe shēnsù de lìshǐ wénhuà yìyùn.
example_sentences.en: Idioms form an exceptionally expressive part of the Chinese lexical treasury, four short characters holding deep cultural connotations.
example_sentences.es: Los modismos integran una parcela extraordinariamente expresiva del léxico chino; cuatro breves caracteres encierran una honda resonancia histórica.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在第二语言习得过程中，广泛阅读是快速扩大学习者词汇储备并培养地道语感的最有效途径。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài dì-èr yǔyán xídé guòchéng zhōng, guǎngfàn yuèdú shì kuàisù kuòdà xuéxízhě cíhuì chǔbèi bìng péiyǎng dìdào yǔgǎn de zuì yǒuxiào tújìng.
example_sentences.en: In second language acquisition, extensive reading is the most effective avenue for rapidly expanding vocabulary reserves and nurturing intuition.
example_sentences.es: En el aprendizaje de segundas lenguas, la lectura asidua constituye la vía más fecunda para ensanchar el caudal de vocabulario y afinar el sentido del idioma.

idioms.meaning_en: words are simple but meaning is profound
subtle words carrying sublime, profound principles
every word is a shining pearl; exquisite literary style
widely read with retentive encyclopedic memory

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 詞. Phono-semantic compound: speech radical 讠 paired with 司 (official decree/governing), meaning officially governed spoken phrases.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Formulating words (讠) under the strict command and governance of grammar (司) creates a distinct word (词).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Articular palabras (讠) bajo la pauta rectora de la expresión ordenada (司) alumbra un término preciso (词).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 彙 and 滙. Water 氵 converging into a deep reservoir 匚, or hedgehog spikes gathering together 彙.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Clear water streams (氵) flowing from all mountain valleys converge into a rich central basin (匚) to assemble (汇).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Las corrientes de agua (氵) que bajan de los valles confluyen en un estanque común (匚) reuniéndose en manantial (汇).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 语言是思想的直接载体，而丰富生动的词汇则是心灵表达的七彩画笔。一个人掌握的词汇越充盈，他对大千世界的观察便越精微，精神内涵也就越深邃。在阅读经典的漫长过程中积累词汇，便是在为自己的灵魂构筑殿堂。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yǔyán shì sīxiǎng de zhíjiē zàitǐ, ér fēngfù shēngdòng de cíhuì zé shì xīnlíng biǎodá de qīcǎi huàbǐ. Yí gè rén zhǎngwò de cíhuì yuè chōngyíng, tā duì dàqiān-shìjiè de guānchá biàn yuè jīngwēi, jīngshén nèihán yě jiù yuè shēnsù. Zài yuèdú jīngdiǎn de màncháng guòchéng zhōng jīlěi cíhuì, biàn shì zài wèi zìjǐ de línghún gòuzhù diàntáng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Language is the carrier of thought, and vivid vocabulary is the paintbrush of the soul. The richer a person's vocabulary, the more subtle their observations of the world, and the deeper their spirit. Accumulating words while reading classics builds palaces for the soul.
extended_reading_passages.es: La lengua es cauce del pensamiento y el rico léxico el pincel multicolor del espíritu. Cuanto mayor es el caudal de vocabulario, más penetrante se torna la mirada sobre el mundo y más hondo el entendimiento. Atesorar palabras leyendo a los clásicos es erigir un templo para el alma.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代计算语言学中，大规模语料库为构建多维度现代汉语词汇语义知识库提供了坚实支撑。通过分析海量数字化文本中的词汇共现与搭配规律，机器能够更自然地理解人类语义，推动自然语言处理技术的跨越式突破。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài jìsuàn yǔyánxué zhōng, dàguīmó yǔliàokù wèi gòujiàn duōwéidù xiàndài Hànyǔ cíhuì yánjí zhīshìkù tígōng le jiānshí zhīchēng. Tōngguò fēnxī hǎiliàng shùzìhuà wénběn zhōng de cíhuì gòngxiàn yǔ dāpèi guīlǜ, jīqì nénggòu gèng zìrán de lǐjiě rénlèi yǔyì, tuīdòng zìrán yǔyán chǔlǐ jìshù de kuàyuèshì tūpò.
extended_reading_passages.en: In computational linguistics, large corpora support multi-dimensional Chinese lexical semantic ontologies. Analyzing word co-occurrences in digitized texts allows machines to comprehend human semantics naturally, driving leaps in NLP.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la lingüística computacional, los corpus masivos sustentan bases de conocimiento léxico-semántico multidimensionales. El análisis de colocaciones y coocurrencias textuales permite a las máquinas captar el sentido del habla, propiciando saltos históricos en el procesamiento del lenguaje natural.

meanings_summary.en: fixed; regular; settled; stationary; to fasten; to immobilize
meanings_summary.es: fijo; regular; estacionario; inmutable; sujetar; inmovilizar; afianzar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Enclosing something behind ancient walls (固) beneath a sturdy domestic roof (定) locks it in place as fixed and permanent (固定).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Proteger algo tras sólidas murallas (固) bajo el cobijo de un techo firme (定) lo deja sujeto e inmutable (固定).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient architectural and ritual engineering, 固定 represented physical anchoring that resisted the shifting forces of floods and wind. In language, it embodies the grammatical stabilization of lexicalized chunks that resist ad-hoc mutation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual falling 4th tones: 'gù dìng' (51-51). Articulate both syllables with firm, crisp, descending pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 固定 expresses spatial stability, unchanging constancy, or deliberate physical tethering in contrast with fluid motion.

contrasts.analysis: 固定 means unchanging, stationary, or physically bolted down (固定结构, 固定资产), whereas 稳定 means steady, balanced, and free from violent fluctuation or crisis (社会稳定, 情绪稳定).
固定 emphasizes remaining unaltered and stationary, whereas 确定 emphasizes making a definite verification or arriving at certainty.
Direct antonym: 固定 is static and permanent (固定资金), while 流动 is mobile, shifting, and liquid (流动人口, 流动资产).

senses.definition_en: firmly established, settled, stationary, or unvarying; unchanging
senses.definition_es: firmemente establecido, invariable, estacionario o constante
senses.example_phrase: 固定的格式 (fixed format)

senses.definition_en: to fasten, anchor, bind, or secure something in place so it cannot move
senses.definition_es: sujetar, afianzar, fijar o inmovilizar algo en una posición fija
senses.example_phrase: 固定帐篷 (fasten the tent)

example_sentences.hanzi: 汉语成语大多拥有经过数千年锤炼而形成的固定结构，通常不能凭个人喜好随意增减或替换字词。
example_sentences.pinyin: Hànyǔ chéngyǔ dàduō yǒngyǒu jīngguò shù qiān nián chuíliàn ér xíngchéng de gùdìng jiégòu, tōngcháng bùnéng píng gèrén xǐhào suíyì zēngjiǎn huò tìhuàn zìcí.
example_sentences.en: Most Chinese idioms possess fixed structures forged over millennia, and usually cannot be casually altered or substituted at personal whim.
example_sentences.es: La mayoría de los modismos chinos poseen una estructura fija forjada a lo largo de milenios, que no debe alterarse ni sustituirse al capricho personal.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了确保高空作业安全，施工人员用多根高强度钢丝绳将脚手架牢牢固定在坚固的混凝土主梁上。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo gāokōng zuòyè ānquán, shīgōng rényuán yòng duō gēn gāoxiàngdù gāngsīshéng jiāng jiǎoshǒujià láoláo gùdìng zài jiāngù de hùnníngtǔ zhǔliáng shàng.
example_sentences.en: To ensure safety during high-altitude operations, workers securely fastened the scaffolding to concrete girders with steel cables.
example_sentences.es: Para garantizar la seguridad en andamios de gran altura, los operarios sujetaron la estructura a la viga maestra de hormigón con recios cables de acero.

idioms.meaning_en: solid, sturdy, and durable
deep-rooted and firmly entrenched
solidly fortified like an iron bastion
magical needle calming the ocean; stabilizing anchor

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram showing an ancient fortress wall 囗 reinforced by ancient shields 古, representing unbending solidity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Ancient traditions and weapons (古) protected securely behind city enclosure walls (囗) remain firm and solid (固).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El saber y los escudos de los antiguos (古) guarnecidos tras las murallas (囗) permanecen firmes e inmutables (固).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram of a foot 疋 stepping into a peaceful home 宀 and standing still without moving.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Resting one's feet securely inside a peaceful sheltered room (宀) brings fixed calm and repose (定).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Asentar las plantas de los pies bajo el reposo del hogar (宀) afianza el equilibrio y sosiega el rumbo (定).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 世界上没有一成不变的事物，看似固定的山川河岳，在漫长的地质岁月中也经历着沧海桑田的变迁。真正成熟的智慧，是在变化中寻找确定性，在固定的法则与灵活的变通之间找到平衡，从而保持内心的丰盈与从容。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shìjiè shàng méiyǒu yìchéng-búbiàn de shìwù, kànsì gùdìng de shānchuān-héyuè, zài màncháng de dìzhì suìyuè zhōng yě jīnglì zhe cānghǎi-sāngtián de biànqiān. Zhēnzhèng chéngshú de zhìhuì, shì zài biànhuà zhōng xúnzhǎo quèdìngxìng, zài gùdìng de fǎzé yǔ línghuó de biàntōng zhījiān zhǎodào pínghéng, cóng'ér bǎochí nèixīn de fēngyíng yǔ cóngróng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Nothing is permanent; mountains that appear fixed undergo epochal shifts over geological eras. Mature wisdom finds certainty amid flux, balancing fixed principles and flexible adaptations to sustain inner poise.
extended_reading_passages.es: Nada en el mundo es inmutable; las cordilleras que parecen eternas sufren mudanzas profundas a lo largo de las eras. La sabiduría madura halla la certeza en el cambio, equilibrando las normas fijas con la flexibilidad para preservar la paz del alma.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代企业管理制度建设中，固定的组织架构必须辅以敏捷高效的跨部门协同机制。面对日新月异的技术变革与市场波动，适时打破僵化的固定壁垒，能够有效激发基层员工的主观能动性与创新创造活力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài qǐyè guǎnlǐ zhìdù jiànshè zhōng, gùdìng de zǔzhī jiàgòu bìxū fǔyǐ mǐnjié gāoxiào de kuà-bùmén xiétóng jīzhì. Miànduì rìxīn-yuèyì de jìshù biàngé yǔ shìchǎng bōdòng, shìshí dǎpò jiānghuà de gùdìng bìlěi, nénggòu yǒuxiào jīfā jīcéng yuángōng de zhǔguān néngdòngxìng yǔ chuàngxīn chuàngzào huólì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern management, fixed structures must be coupled with agile cross-departmental mechanisms. Facing rapid tech changes, breaking rigid institutional walls liberates grassroots initiative and creative vitality.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la gestión corporativa moderna, el organigrama fijo debe articularse con dinámicas ágiles de colaboración. Ante el vertiginoso ritmo de la innovación, flexibilizar las estructuras rígidas desata la creatividad y el talento de los empleados.

meanings_summary.en: structure; composition; construction; framework; architecture of a system
meanings_summary.es: estructura; composición; entramado; conformación interna; arquitectura de un sistema

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Tying cords together (结) to interlock sturdy wooden roof beams (构) assembles the overarching architecture and structure (结构).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Trabar ligaduras (结) que ensamblan las vigas maestras (构) levanta el armazón y la estructura (结构).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese architectural theory (营造法式), 结构 specifically designated the dougong bracket sets (斗栱) and interlocking mortise-and-tenon timbers that distributed roof weight safely without nails. Metaphorically, it expanded into literary composition, sentence syntax, and macro-economics.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'jié gòu' (35-51). Rise smoothly on 'jié', then strike down firmly on 'gòu'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 结构 emphasizes the internal relationship and organizational pattern among components of an organic whole.

contrasts.analysis: 结构 emphasizes the relational framework and balance between parts (句子结构, 产业结构), whereas 构造 emphasizes the mechanical manufacture, geological formation, or structural anatomy (地质构造, 机械构造).
结构 is the static arrangement of pieces, whereas 组织 refers either to dynamic living biological tissue or human sociopolitical institutions.
结构 includes all internal connections and balance, while 骨架 refers strictly to the bare structural skeleton or load-bearing ribs.

senses.definition_en: the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex; internal framework
senses.definition_es: disposición y trabazón de las partes que integran un todo complejo; entramado
senses.example_phrase: 语法结构 (grammatical structure)

example_sentences.hanzi: 四字成语大多具有高度对称的语法结构，如主谓、并列或动宾搭配，体现出汉语对仗工整的独特审美。
example_sentences.pinyin: Sì zì chéngyǔ dàduō jùyǒu gāodù duìchèn de yǔfǎ jiégòu, rú zhǔwèi, bìngliè huò dòngbīn dāpèi, tǐxiàn chū Hànyǔ duìzhàng-gōngzhěng de dútè shěnměi.
example_sentences.en: Four-character idioms mostly possess symmetrical grammatical structures like subject-predicate or coordinate pairs, manifesting Chinese aesthetics.
example_sentences.es: Los modismos de cuatro caracteres suelen presentar estructuras gramaticales simétricas que revelan la admirable estética armónica del chino.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这座历经千年风雨的古代木结构塔楼，凭借精巧的榫卯连接，在多次大地震中依然巍然挺立、完好无损。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò lìjīng qiānnián fēngyǔ de gǔdài mùjiégòu tǎlóu, píngjiè jīngqiǎo de sǔnmǎo liánjiē, zài duō cì dà dìzhèn zhōng yīrán wēirán tǐnglì, wánhǎo-wúsǔn.
example_sentences.en: This thousand-year-old timber pagoda, through ingenious mortise-and-tenon joints, still stands intact through earthquakes.
example_sentences.es: Esta pagoda milenaria de madera, gracias a su ensamblaje de caja y espiga, ha resistido fuertes seísmos manteniéndose erguida e incólume.

idioms.meaning_en: deconstruct and reorganize
intricate and complex; tangled web
hammered a thousand times; thoroughly tempered
possess unique ingenuity; original craftsmanship

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: silk thread 纟 tied into an auspicious knot 吉, symbolizing binding structural elements firmly.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Weaving strong silk cords (纟) into an auspicious, unbreakable knot (吉) firmly binds components together (结).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Hebras de seda firme (纟) anudadas con ventura (吉) traban los elementos de un conjunto (结).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 構. Ancient pictogram of timber logs 木 interlocked using hooked joinery 勾 to build eaves.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Hooking timber beams (木) together with precision joints (勾) frames the skeleton of a building (构).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ensamblar vigas de madera (木) con ganchos y espigas (勾) levanta el armazón de un edificio (构).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 走进古典园林，回廊与漏窗之间巧妙的层次结构总能引人入胜。移步换景的精妙设计，打破了原本狭小的物理空间局限，使假山、清池与修竹在错落有致的布局中融为一体，展现出东方营建哲学的高超智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǒujìn gǔdiǎn yuánlín, huíláng yǔ lòuchuāng zhījiān qiǎomiào de céngcì jiégòu zǒng néng yǐnrén-rùshèng. Yíbù-huànjǐng de jīngmiào shèjì, dǎpò le yuánběn xiáxiǎo de wùlǐ kōngjiān júxiàn, shǐ jiǎshān, qīngchí yǔ xiūzhú zài cuòluò-yǒuzhì de bùjú zhōng róngwéiyìtǐ, zhǎnshì chū dōngfāng yíngjiàn zhéxué de gāochāo zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Entering classical gardens, the subtle layered structures between verandas and openwork windows enchant. Changing scenes at every step transcend physical confines, blending artificial peaks, ponds, and bamboo into architectural harmony.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los jardines clásicos, el juego estructural entre corredores y celosías cautiva la mirada. Su diseño altera la percepción espacial integrando riscos artificiales, estanques y bambúes en una primorosa lección de arquitectura oriental.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在经济全球化面临深刻调整的背景下，优化升级国内产业链与供给侧结构已成为保障经济韧性的关键举措。通过推动传统产业数字化转型，培育战略性新兴产业集群，中国经济正向更高质量的发展轨道坚实迈进。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài jīngjì quánqiúhuà miànlín shēnkè tiáozhěng de bèijǐng xià, yōuhuà shēngjí guónèi chǎnyèliàn yǔ gōngjǐcè jiégòu yǐ chéngwéi bǎozhàng jīngjì rènxìng de guānjiàn jǔcuò. Tōngguò tuīdòng chuántǒng chǎnyè shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng, péiyù zhànlüèxìng xīnxīng chǎnyè jíqún, Zhōngguó jīngjì zhèng xiàng gèng gāozhìliàng de fāzhǎn guǐdào jiānshí màijìn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid shifts in economic globalization, upgrading domestic industrial and supply-side structures is critical for resilience. Fostering digital transformation and emerging clusters propels the economy toward high-quality development.
extended_reading_passages.es: Frente a la reorganización económica global, optimizar las cadenas productivas y la estructura de la oferta es vital para la resiliencia. La digitalización fabril y los sectores estratégicos afianzan un crecimiento de alta calidad.

meanings_summary.en: whole; entirety; totality; holistic entity; integrated macrocosm
meanings_summary.es: todo; totalidad; conjunto; entidad integral; macrocosmos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When every part is arranged in perfect, complete order (整) within a single living body (体), it forms an organic whole (整体).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando cada elemento se ordena con pulcritud (整) dentro de un solo cuerpo vivo (体), cobra vida la totalidad (整体).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In traditional Chinese cosmology (天人合一), the universe is not a collection of isolated atoms but an indivisible holistic body (有机整体). In classical medicine (中医学), bodily illness is treated not by local excision alone, but through balancing the whole systemic organism (整体观念).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual dipping 3rd tones: 'zhěng tǐ'. Under standard Mandarin tone sandhi, the first 3rd tone changes to rising 2nd tone: 'zhéng tǐ' (35-214).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 整体 denotes an integrated macrocosm where individual components are organically synthesized into a higher unit.

contrasts.analysis: 全部 refers simply to the full quantitative sum or entirety of items (全部人员), whereas 整体 emphasizes qualitative, systemic synergy among components (有机整体).
Direct antonym: 整体 is the comprehensive macroscopic whole, while 局部 refers to an isolated, localized section or subsystem.
全体 typically modifies groups of living human members (全体员工, 全体人民), while 整体 is broader and philosophical, modifying abstract concepts, plans, and structures.

Has 木 on the right instead of 本
Lacks person radical 亻 on the left

senses.definition_en: a comprehensive whole consisting of interdependent parts; totality as opposed to isolated parts
senses.definition_es: totalidad orgánica integrada por partes interdependientes; conjunto global
senses.example_phrase: 整体考虑 (consider as a whole)

example_sentences.hanzi: 成语的深层含义往往是一个有机的整体，学习者不能仅仅停留在字面含义的简单相加，而要结合历史语境去体会。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chéngyǔ de shēncéng hányì wǎngwǎng shì yí gè yǒujī de zhěngtǐ, xuéxízhě bùnéng jǐnjǐn tíngliú zài zìmiàn hányì de jiǎndān xiāngjiā, ér yào jiéhé lìshǐ yǔjìng qù tǐhuì.
example_sentences.en: An idiom's deep meaning is an organic whole; learners cannot simply add up literal meanings, but must intuit them through historical context.
example_sentences.es: El sentido profundo de un modismo constituye una totalidad orgánica; el estudiante no debe sumar los significados literales, sino captarlo en su contexto histórico.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在制定城市更新规划时，设计师必须将生态保护与老街区的人文风貌作为一个不可分割的整体通盘考虑。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng chéngshì gēngxīn guīhuà shí, shèjìshī bìxū jiāng shēngtài bǎohù yǔ lǎojiēqū de rénwén fēngmào zuòwéi yí gè bùkě-fēngē de zhěngtǐ tōngpán kǎolǜ.
example_sentences.en: In urban renewal planning, architects must consider ecological preservation and historic heritage as an indivisible integrated whole.
example_sentences.es: Al planificar la remodelación urbana, los arquitectos deben contemplar la ecología y el patrimonio histórico como un todo indisoluble.

collocations.en: viewed as a whole; from a macro perspective

idioms.meaning_en: integrated into a harmonious whole; seamless unity
take the overarching situation as paramount
plan holistically and take all factors into consideration
generalize the whole from an isolated part

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining upright 正, discipline 敕, and binding ties, meaning disciplining and arranging all components into complete order.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Disciplining and arranging all items with precision action (攵) to keep them upright (正) creates complete order (整).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ordenar con pulso disciplinado (攵) las piezas para que queden rectas (正) forja un conjunto cabal (整).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 體 (bones 骨 arranged into ritual vessels 豊). Person 亻 rooted to their foundational trunk 本 forms the body.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A human being (亻) rooted firmly to their biological trunk and foundation (本) possesses an organic body (体).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un ser humano (亻) enraizado firmemente en su tronco vital (本) da forma a su cuerpo orgánico (体).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 欣赏一幅传世的宋代山水画，不能只将目光局限于某一块山石或几株苍松的笔墨，而要用心领会画面整体的气韵与留白。那虚实相生、远近相衬的布局，使整幅画作浑然一体，传递出古人对天地大美的崇高敬畏。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xīnshǎng yì fú chuánshì de Sòngdài shānshuǐhuà, bùnéng zhǐ jiāng mùguāng júxiàn yú mǒu yí kuài shānshí huò jǐ zhū cāngsōng de bǐmò, ér yào yòngxīn lǐnghuì huàmiàn zhěngtǐ de qìyùn yǔ liúbái. Nà xūshí-xiāngshēng, yuǎnjìn-xiāngchèn de bùjú, shǐ zhěng fú huàzuò húnrán-yìtǐ, chuándì chū gǔrén duì tiāndì dàměi de chónggāo jìngwèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Savoring Song landscapes, one cannot restrict vision to isolated rocks or pine strokes; one must perceive the whole rhythm and negative space. Interplay of presence and void unites the painting into a seamless whole, echoing reverence for cosmic beauty.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al contemplar un paisaje de la dinastía Song, la mirada no debe limitarse a un risco o a un pino aislado, sino abarcar la armonía y los vacíos del conjunto. El juego de luces y sombras confiere unidad a la obra, revelando la devoción de los antiguos ante el cosmos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在统筹推进生态文明建设的伟大实践中，我们必须牢固树立山水林田湖草沙是生命共同体的整体系统观念。唯有遵循自然生态各要素之间的内在循环规律，坚持全方位、全地域、全过程的整体保护，才能筑牢国家永续发展的生态安全屏障。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài tǒngchóu tuījìn shēngtài wénmíng jiànshè de wěidà shíjiàn zhōng, wǒmen bìxū láogù shùlì shān shuǐ lín tián hú cǎo shā shì shēngmìng gòngtóngtǐ de zhěngtǐ xìtǒng guānniàn. Wéiyǒu zūnxún zìrán shēngtài gè yàosù zhījiān de nèizài xúnhuán guīlǜ, jiānchí quánfāngwèi, quán-dìyù, quán-guòchéng de zhěngtǐ bǎohù, cáinéng zhùláo guójiā yǒngxù fāzhǎn de shēngtài ānquán píngzhàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In advancing ecological civilization, we must maintain a holistic view that mountains, waters, forests, and lakes form an integrated community of life. Adhering to systemic preservation alone erects lasting ecological barriers.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al consolidar la civilización ecológica, es imperativo concebir montañas, aguas, bosques y praderas como un organismo vivo indisociable. Solo acatando las leyes de los ecosistemas y preservando el conjunto se levantará un escudo de desarrollo sostenible.

meanings_summary.en: to synthesize; to integrate; to sum up; comprehensive; synthesized; composite
meanings_summary.es: sintetizar; integrar; compendiar; sintetizado; global; integral

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Weaving thousands of silk threads together on a loom (综) and joining them tightly with a matching lid (合) produces a comprehensive synthesis (综合).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Entretejer miles de hilos en el telar (综) y ajustarlos en una sola vasija (合) produce una síntesis cabal (综合).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese sericulture and weaving, 综 was the heddle frame coordinating warp and weft into cloth. From textile weaving, 综合 developed into the classical philosophical term for inductive synthesis, paired against dialectical analysis (分析).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'zōng hé' (55-35). Start with a level high pitch before sweeping smoothly upward.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 综合 highlights integrating distinct components, viewpoints, or data streams into a cohesive unified result.

contrasts.analysis: Direct dialectical antonym: 综合 integrates parts into a whole (synthesis), whereas 分析 breaks a whole down into its individual components (analysis).
综合 emphasizes multi-factorial integration and cross-referencing, while 总结 emphasizes summarizing the accomplishments or lessons learned over a past period.
综合 is analytical and cognitive (综合判断), while 整合 is structural and operational, such as reorganizing company resources or corporate departments.

Has mountain radical 山 at top above 宗
Has wood radical 木 on the left instead of 纟
Has dish radical 皿 at bottom instead of 口
Has bamboo radical 竹 at top above 合

senses.definition_en: to combine or integrate separate elements, factors, or data into a coherent unified whole
senses.definition_es: reunir, integrar o combinar elementos, datos o factores dispersos en un todo coherente
senses.example_phrase: 综合分析 (synthesize and analyze)

senses.definition_en: consisting of diverse components or aspects; comprehensive; multi-disciplinary
senses.definition_es: que abarca múltiples aspectos o disciplinas; omnicomprensivo; global
senses.example_phrase: 综合大学 (comprehensive university)

example_sentences.hanzi: 成语的整体意义绝非每个字面意思的简单综合，而是凝聚了特定的历史典故与文化隐喻。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chéngyǔ de zhěngtǐ yìyì juéfēi měi gè zìmiàn yìsi de jiǎndān zōnghé, érshì níngjù le tèdìng de lìshǐ diǎngù yǔ wénhuà yǐnyù.
example_sentences.en: An idiom's overarching meaning is by no means a simple synthesis of literal characters, but crystallizes historical allusions.
example_sentences.es: El sentido general de un modismo dista de ser una mera síntesis de sus caracteres aislados, pues condensa fábulas históricas y metáforas culturales.

example_sentences.hanzi: 专家组在深入考察了地理环境、交通网络与产业配套后，对新区的开发方案进行了客观科学的综合评估。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiāzǔ zài shēnrù kǎochá le dìlǐ huánjìng, jiāotōng wǎnglù yǔ chǎnyè pèitào hòu, duì xīnqū de kāifā fāng'àn jìnxíng le kèguān kēxué de zōnghé pínggū.
example_sentences.en: After inspecting terrain, transit, and industrial zoning, the panel conducted a scientific, comprehensive evaluation of the zone.
example_sentences.es: Tras evaluar el entorno, las comunicaciones y el tejido industrial, el comité de expertos realizó una rigurosa valoración integral del nuevo distrito.

idioms.meaning_en: take a comprehensive view of the overall situation
achieve comprehensive mastery through thorough integration
draw extensively upon the strengths of diverse schools
incorporate and absorb things of diverse natures

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 綜. Ancient pictogram of a loom's heddle guiding thousands of warp threads 纟 into an orderly fabric.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Thousands of silk threads (纟) gathered beneath the ancestral temple roof (宗) are woven into a single synthesis (综).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Miles de hebras de seda (纟) reunidas bajo el templo ancestral (宗) se entretejen en una síntesis ordenada (综).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram of a lid 亼 fitting securely over a box mouth 口, signifying closing, uniting, and joining.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A matching lid (亼) fits perfectly over the mouth of a container (口), joining two halves into one (合).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una tapadera a medida (亼) ajusta a la perfección sobre la boca de la vasija (口), uniendo ambas partes en armonía (合).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对错综复杂的人生境遇，片面的主观臆断往往容易使人误入歧途。唯有学会综合听取各方意见，在冷静观察中权衡利弊得失，才能在纷繁复杂的迷雾中看清前进的方向，做出真正经得起岁月检验的理性抉择。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì cuòzōng-fùzá de rénshēng jìngyù, piànmiàn de zhǔguān yìduàn wǎngwǎng róngyì shǐ rén wùrù-qítú. Wéiyǒu xuéhuì zōnghé tīngqǔ gèfāng yìjiàn, zài lěngjìng guānchá zhōng quánhéng lìbì-déshī, cáinéng zài fēnfán-fùzá de míwù zhōng kànqīng qiánjìn de fāngxiàng, zuòchū zhēnzhèng jīngdeqǐ suìyuè jiǎnyàn de lǐxìng juézé.
extended_reading_passages.en: Facing intricate circumstances, one-sided guesswork easily leads astray. Only by synthesizing diverse views and weighing pros and cons in calm reflection can one pierce confusing fogs to make rational choices that endure through time.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante los complejos avatares del vivir, las suposiciones sesgadas extravían el camino. Solo ponderando con criterio integral los pareceres y sopesando pros y contras se disipa la bruma para forjar decisiones juiciosas que venzan al tiempo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在新一轮全球产业革命深入演进的浪潮中，跨学科交叉融合已成为颠覆性创新的重要源泉。一流大学正积极探索建设新型综合实验平台，打破传统学院学科壁垒，旨在培养能够综合运用前沿科技攻克国家重大战略难题的复合型英才。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xīn yí lùn quánqiú chǎnyè gémìng shēnrù yǎnjìn de làngcháo zhōng, kuà-xuékē jiāochā rónghé yǐ chéngwéi diānfùxìng chuàngxīn de zhòngyào yuánquán. Yīliú dàxué zhèng jījí tànsuǒ jiànshè xīnxíng zōnghé shíyàn píngtái, dǎpò chuántǒng xuéyuàn xuékē bìlěi, zhǐzài péiyǎng nénggòu zōnghé yùnyòng qiányán kējì gōngkè guójiā zhòngdà zhànlüè nándí de fùhéxíng yīngcái.
extended_reading_passages.en: In global industrial revolutions, interdisciplinary convergence is a fountainhead of innovation. Top universities are building integrated platforms, breaking departmental silos to nurture versatile talent adept at synthesizing technologies to solve strategic challenges.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la actual revolución industrial, la hibridación interdisciplinaria es manantial de hallazgos punteros. Las grandes universidades construyen plataformas de investigación integral que derriban barreras departamentales, forjando talentos capaces de coordinar tecnologías estratégicas.

meanings_summary.en: philosopher; scholar specializing in philosophical inquiry and epistemology
meanings_summary.es: filósofo; pensador consagrado a la filosofía, la ontología y el pensamiento crítico

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A wise sage (哲) who dedicates a lifetime to study (学) in the household of ideas (家) becomes a celebrated philosopher (哲学家).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un sabio lúcido (哲) consagrado al estudio (学) en el hogar del conocimiento (家) se erige en eminente filósofo (哲学家).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 哲 (wisdom/sagacity) dates back to the Shangshu (尚书: 知人则哲). In the late 19th century, Nishi Amane coined the Sino-Japanese neologism 哲学 to translate Western 'philosophia' (love of wisdom). Suffixing 家 (master/school) created 哲学家.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising, rising, high: 'zhé xué jiā' (35-35-55). Ascend smoothly across 'zhé' and 'xué', finishing with a sustained high pitch on 'jiā'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 哲学家 specifically designates a deep academic or historical thinker who investigates fundamental ontology and logic.

contrasts.compared_word: 哲学家 vs. 思想家
contrasts.analysis: 哲学家 focuses strictly on philosophical metaphysics, ontology, and epistemology, whereas 思想家 is broader, including sociopolitical thinkers and cultural reformers (e.g. Lu Xun).

contrasts.compared_word: 哲学家 vs. 科学家
contrasts.analysis: 哲学家 pursues conceptual and rational reflection on ultimate meaning and ethics, while 科学家 investigates empirical physical reality through experimental methods.
学者 is a general academic term for any university researcher, whereas 哲学家 is specifically an expert in philosophy.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the mouth radical 口 at the bottom
Has words radical 言 at bottom instead of 口
Has 子 inside 宀 without the top crown strokes
Has 冖 and 豕 with extra dot strokes
Has 亠 and 口 at top above 豕

senses.definition_en: a scholar, thinker, or intellectual who engages in the study of fundamental questions concerning existence, knowledge, ethics, and reason
senses.definition_es: pensador o erudito dedicado al estudio de los enigmas fundamentales de la existencia, el conocimiento y la moral
senses.example_phrase: 古代哲学家 (ancient philosopher)

example_sentences.hanzi: 古代哲学家庄子善于用寓言故事启迪世人，以“朝三暮四”的生动比喻揭示了物我两忘、齐同得失的豁达心境。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gǔdài zhéxuéjiā Zhuāngzǐ shànyú yòng yùyán gùshì qǐdí shìrén, yǐ 'zhāosān-mùsì' de shēngdòng bǐyù jiēshì le wùwǒ-liǎngwàng, qítóng-déshī de huòdá xīnjìng.
example_sentences.en: The ancient philosopher Zhuangzi excelled at enlightening people with allegories, using the metaphor of 'Zhao San Mu Si' to reveal transcendence of gain.
example_sentences.es: El filósofo de la antigüedad Zhuangzi ilustraba sus enseñanzas con alegorías, valiéndose de la fábula de los monos para mostrar la sabia serenidad ante la pérdida.

example_sentences.hanzi: 伟大的哲学家不仅关注终极的形而上学本体之问，更致力于通过理性思辨为人类社会构建公平正义的伦理准则。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wěidà de zhéxuéjiā bùjǐn guānzhù zhōngjí de xíng'érshàngxué běntǐ zhī wèn, gèng zhìlì yú tōngguò lǐxìng sībiàn wèi rénlèi shèhuì gòujiàn gōngpíng-zhèngyì de lúnlǐ zhǔnzé.
example_sentences.en: Great philosophers not only ponder ultimate ontological inquiries, but strive to construct ethical standards of justice through rational contemplation.
example_sentences.es: Los grandes filósofos no solo escrutan las preguntas ontológicas fundamentales, sino que erigen normas éticas de justicia y convivencia a través de la razón.

idioms.meaning_en: he who is contented is always happy; philosophical serenity
the old frontiersman lost his horse; blessing in disguise
things turn into their opposites when reaching extremes
the greatest truth is concise and simple

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram: an axe cutting and discerning 折 truth, spoken by a mouth 口 with sharp sagacity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A sharp mind cuts through confusing arguments like an axe (折) and articulates truth through the mouth (口) with wisdom (哲).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mente que hendi los engaños como hacha certera (折) y pronuncia la verdad con la boca (口) alumbra la sabiduría (哲).

character_decomposition.meaning_en: study; learn; science; branch of knowledge
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 學. Ancient pictogram of a child 子 beneath schoolroom eaves guided by teachers' hands to learn.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Under the sheltering school roof, a curious young student (子) receives guidance from teachers to learn (学).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el alero de la escuela, un niño despierto (子) recibe la guía atenta de sus maestros para aprender (学).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of a domestic pig 豕 sheltered beneath a home roof 宀. Extensively suffixed for master scholars.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Beneath the safe shelter of a home roof (宀), deep lifetime mastery establishes a distinguished expert and scholar (家).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el amparo de un techo seguro (宀), la consagración de una vida de estudio encumbra a un maestro consumado (家).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 真正的哲学家从来不是脱离现实的书斋隐士，而是人类灵魂深处的守望者。他们以冷峻深邃的目光凝视尘世的喧嚣，在看似不容置疑的日常教条中提出震聋发聩的发问，引领大众穿透表象的迷雾，寻找生命的真谛。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de zhéxuéjiā cónglái búshì tuōlí xiànshí de shūzhāi yǐnshì, érshì rénlèi línghún shēnchù de shǒuwàngzhě. Tāmen yǐ lěngjùn shēnsù de mùguāng níngshì chénshì de xuāoxiāo, zài kànsì bùróng-zhìyí de rìcháng jiàotiáo zhōng tíchū zhènlóng-fākuì de fāwèn, yǐnlǐng dàzhòng chuāntòu biǎoxiàng de míwù, xúnzhǎo shēngmìng de zhēndì.
extended_reading_passages.en: True philosophers are never hermits detached from reality, but guardians of humanity's soul. With piercing gaze they observe worldly tumult, raising provocative questions to guide people through mists of illusion toward truth.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los filósofos genuinos jamás son ermitaños ajenos al mundo, sino centinelas del alma humana. Con mirada serena escrutan el fragor cotidiano formulando preguntas audaces que disipan la bruma en pos del sentido del existir.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在科技与物质文明突飞猛进的当下，哲学家的审思与人文关怀显得尤为不可或缺。面对基因编辑与强人工智能等前沿伦理挑战，哲学家所提供的价值反思与理性底线，为人类文明在技术狂飙中守住了永恒的道德灯塔。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài kējì yǔ wùzhí wénmíng tūfēi-měngjìn de dāngxià, zhéxuéjiā de shěnsī yǔ rénwén guānhuái xiǎnde yóuwéi bùkě-huòquē. Miànduì jīyīn biānjí yǔ qiáng réngōngzhìnéng děng qiányán lúnlǐ tiǎozhàn, zhéxuéjiā suǒ tígōng de jiàzhí fǎnsī yǔ lǐxìng dǐxiàn, wèi rénlèi wénmíng zài jìshù kuángbiāo zhōng shǒuzhù le yǒnghéng de dàodé dēngtǎ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid leaps in material tech, philosophers' reflections are indispensable. Facing genetic editing and AI ethics, their philosophical values and moral boundaries preserve an eternal moral beacon for civilization amidst technical storms.
extended_reading_passages.es: En pleno auge tecnológico y material, las reflexiones de los filósofos resultan insustituibles. Frente a la edición genética y la inteligencia artificial, sus dilemas éticos resguardan el faro moral del progreso de la civilización.

meanings_summary.en: fable; allegory; parable; short moral narrative using animals or symbols
meanings_summary.es: fábula; alegoría; parábola; relato moral con animales o símbolos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Lodging a masked philosophical truth (寓) inside a spoken story of words (言) creates an enduring moral fable (寓言).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Alojar una verdad enmascarada (寓) dentro de la palabra dicha (言) alumbra una fábula imperecedera (寓言).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The term 寓言 was first coined explicitly by Zhuangzi in the chapter 《寓言》: '寓言十九，藉外论之' (Nineteen of twenty are fables, borrowing external characters to speak truth). Ancient Chinese philosophers (Han Feizi, Liezi) used animal parables as powerful rhetorical weapons against authoritarian dogmas.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'yù yán' (51-35). Drop firmly on 'yù', then glide upward smoothly on 'yán'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 寓言 specifically designates a fictional story designed to convey a metaphorical moral or philosophical lesson.

contrasts.analysis: 寓言 is philosophical, moral, and targeted at adult reflection or life lessons (fables like Aesop or Zhuangzi), whereas 童话 consists of fairy tales with magic, princes, and dragons designed for children (Andersen, Grimm).
寓言 is an invented parable used for moral illustration, whereas 神话 consists of ancient cultural myths explaining cosmic origins, gods, and folk heroes (Nuwa, Houyi).
故事 is the generic term for any narrative sequence of events, fiction or non-fiction, while 寓言 must lodge a didactic moral lesson.
