Has walking radical 辶 around 禺
Has person radical 亻 next to 禺
Has person radical 亻 next to 言
Has 十 next to 讠 instead of standalone 言

senses.definition_en: a short, metaphorical narrative (often featuring animals, plants, or legendary figures) designed to convey a moral principle, philosophical lesson, or satirize human follies
senses.definition_es: narración alegórica breve, protagonizada a menudo por animales, que ilustra una lección moral o filosófica
senses.example_phrase: 古代寓言 (ancient fable)

example_sentences.hanzi: 《庄子》一书中收录了大量精妙绝伦的寓言故事，善于以天马行空的想象力阐发深邃玄奥的道家哲学。
example_sentences.pinyin: 《Zhuāngzǐ》 yì shū zhōng shōulù le dàliàng jīngmiào-juélún de yùyán gùshì, shànyú yǐ tiānmǎ-xíngkōng de xiǎngxiànglì chǎnfā shēnsù xuán'ào de Dàojiā zhéxué.
example_sentences.en: The book of Zhuangzi collects exquisite fables, utilizing boundless imagination to elucidate profound Daoist philosophy.
example_sentences.es: La obra de Zhuangzi atesora admirables fábulas que, valiéndose de una imaginación desbordante, desentrañan la honda metafísica taoísta.

example_sentences.hanzi: 优秀的寓言作品往往文字短小精悍，却能跨越历史长河与国界隔阂，在不同文化的读者心底引起长久的情感共鸣。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yōuxiù de yùyán zuòpǐn wǎngwǎng wénzì duǎnxiǎo-jīnghàn, què néng kuàyuè lìshǐ chánghé yǔ guójiè géhé, zài bùtóng wénhuà de dúzhě xīndǐ yǐnqǐ chángjiǔ de qínggǎn gòngmíng.
example_sentences.en: Superb fables are concise yet punchy, transcending history and borders to evoke enduring emotional resonance across cultures.
example_sentences.es: Las grandes fábulas son breves y certeras, y trascienden épocas y fronteras despertando honda resonancia en lectores de toda cultura.

idioms.meaning_en: rich and far-reaching in moral meaning; deep implication
integrate education with entertainment; teach through pleasure
wait by a tree stump waiting for hares; rely on lucky breaks
draw a snake and add feet; ruin something by superfluous additions

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram: sheltering 宀 someone wearing a ritual monkey mask 禺, meaning temporary lodging, and metaphorically lodging moral truths inside stories.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Beneath the sheltering roof of a story (宀), profound wisdom resides masked in disguise (禺) to imply a moral (寓).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el tejado de un relato alegórico (宀), mora una honda verdad enmascarada (禺) que encierra la fábula (寓).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 言 (mouth with fluted tongue articulating breath)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of a reed flute or tongue 口 issuing measured musical breaths and deliberate words.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A mouth issuing structured breaths across reed flutes speaks deliberate human words (言).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La boca emitiendo un aliento acompasado a través de cañas profiere la palabra razonada (言).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 寓言是文学殿堂中最为轻盈却又最富智慧的花朵。它往往借由小动物的滑稽举止或凡夫俗子的琐碎争执，在莞尔一笑间揭开人性的弱点与社会的弊端。读懂了寓言背后的深邃微言，便读懂了人世间大半的纷扰与执念。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yùyán shì wénxué diàntáng zhōng zuìwéi qīngyíng què yòu zuì fù zhìhuì de huāduǒ. Tā wǎngwǎng jièyóu xiǎodòngwù de huájī jǔzhǐ huò fánfū-súzǐ de suǒsuì zhēngzhí, zài wǎn'ěr-yíxiào jiān jiēkāi rénxìng de ruòdiǎn yǔ shèhuì de bìduān. Dúdǒng le yùyán bèihòu de shēnsù wēiyán, biàn dúdǒng le rénshìjiān dàbàn de fēnrǎo yǔ zhíniàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Fables are the most graceful yet sagacious blossoms in literature's palace. Through animal antics or petty disputes, they unveil human flaws amid smiles. Understanding fables means grasping worldly folly and obsessions.
extended_reading_passages.es: La fábula es la flor más grácil y lúcida de la literatura. Valiéndose de travesuras animales o disputas triviales, desnuda las flaquezas humanas arrancando una sonrisa. Quien comprende la fábula descifra las vanidades del mundo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在当代跨学科叙事学研究中，寓言作为一种古老的认知隐喻工具，正在被广泛应用于组织管理与公众科学传播领域。通过将复杂的系统性原理转译为生动通俗的现代寓言，能够有效突破专业知识壁垒，极大激发公众的求知欲与共情力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dāngdài kuà-xuékē xùshìxué yánjiū zhōng, yùyán zuòwéi yì zhǒng gǔlǎo de rènzhī yǐnyù gōngjù, zhèngzài bèi guǎnfàn yìngyòng yú zǔzhī guǎnlǐ yǔ gōngzhòng kēxué chuánbō lǐngyù. Tōngguò jiāng fùzá de xìtǒngxìng yuánlǐ zhuǎnyì wéi shēngdòng tōngsú de xiàndài yùyán, nénggòu yǒuxiào tūpò zhuānyè zhīshì bìlěi, jídà jīfā gōngzhòng de qiúzhīyù yǔ gòngqínglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In narrative studies, allegory as an ancient cognitive metaphor is widely applied in management and science communication. Translating systemic principles into modern parables bridges barriers, sparking public curiosity and empathy.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la teoría narrativa actual, la alegoría se aplica con éxito a la divulgación científica y la gestión. Verter principios complejos en fábulas amenas derriba barreras de especialidad, despertando la empatía y la sed de saber del público.

meanings_summary.en: to feed; to rear; to raise (animals, infants); to nurture with food
meanings_summary.es: alimentar; criar; cebar; nutrir animales o infantes con esmero

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Putting fresh food into hungry mouths (喂) to gently nurture livestock like sheep (养) means to rear and feed (喂养).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Llevar comida a la boca hambrienta (喂) para nutrir con cariño como al rebaño (养) es alimentar y criar (喂养).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient agrarian life, 养 was sacred: rearing sacrificial animals (养牲) and filial care for aged parents (养亲). Combining with 喂 (the tactile manual act of placing food in a mouth) specifies tender, daily maternal or pastoral feeding.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by dipping 3rd tone: 'wèi yǎng' (51-214). Drop firmly on 'wèi', then allow 'yǎng' to dip into low vocal register.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 喂养 emphasizes providing meals, nutrition, and daily survival care to animals, livestock, or infant children.

contrasts.analysis: 喂养 is warm, domestic, and applicable to pets, babies, or farm animals, whereas 饲养 is a formal agricultural and biological term for raising livestock or lab animals on an industrial scale (饲养场).
喂养 refers to physical feeding of food, while 抚养 is legal, emotional, and social guardianship in raising human children to adulthood (抚养成人).
喂养 is for animals and infants, whereas 培育 is for cultivating botanical plant seedlings, bacterial cultures, or developing abstract talent and virtues.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the mouth radical 口 on the left
Has fire radical 火 on the left instead of 口
Has wood radical 木 on the left instead of 丷
Has 大 at the bottom instead of 𠫤
Has 女 at the bottom instead of 𠫤

senses.definition_en: to provide food, sustenance, and daily care to nurture animals, livestock, pets, or infants
senses.definition_es: proporcionar alimento y cuidados diarios para criar animales, ganado o infantes
senses.example_phrase: 喂养宠物 (feed pets)

example_sentences.hanzi: 从前宋国有一位老人非常喜爱猴子，在自家院子里悉心喂养了一大群活泼机灵的猴子当宠物。
example_sentences.pinyin: Cóngqián Sòngguó yǒu yí wèi lǎorén fēicháng xǐ'ài hóuzi, zài zìjiā yuànzi lǐ xīxīn wèiyǎng le yí dà qún huópo-jīling de hóuzi dāng chǒngwù.
example_sentences.en: Once in the state of Song, an elder loved monkeys, meticulously rearing a large troupe of lively, clever monkeys as pets in his courtyard.
example_sentences.es: Antaño en el reino de Song vivía un anciano amante de los monos, que criaba con desvelo una manada de animales vivaces en su patio como mascotas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了确保救护的野生鸟类顺利重返大自然，野生动物救助站的工作人员严格按照野化训练要求科学喂养幼鸟。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo jiùhù de yěshēng niǎolèi shùnlì chóngfǎn dàzìrán, yěshēng dòngwù jiùzhùzhàn de gōngzuò rényuán yángé ànzhào yěhuà xùnliàn yāoqiú kēxué wèiyǎng yòuniǎo.
example_sentences.en: To ensure rescued wild birds return to nature, wildlife sanctuary staff scientifically feed fledglings following re-wilding requirements.
example_sentences.es: Para asegurar que las aves silvestres rescatadas vuelvan a su hábitat, los operarios del refugio alimentan a los polluelos según pautas de asilvestramiento.

collocations.en: carefully and tenderly feed and rear

idioms.meaning_en: endure bitter hardships to rear children
maternal breastfeeding
rehabilitate the people and let them multiply in peace
brought up in pampered luxury; spoiled

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: mouth radical 口 offering food into the mouth, paired with 畏.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Placing wholesome food directly into the waiting hungry mouth (口) with attentive care feeds and nourishes (喂).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Poner comida nutritiva en la boca abierta y hambrienta (口) con esmero alimenta a la criatura (喂).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 養. Ancient pictogram showing hands feeding an auspicious sheep 羊 fresh fodder to nurture it.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Providing fresh mountain pasture to graze an auspicious sheep (羊) nurtures and rears living beings (养).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pastorear una oveja dócil (羊) en los pastos tiernos alimenta la vida y la hace prosperar (养).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 祖母在农家小院里精心喂养着几只毛茸茸的雏鸡。每天清晨天刚破晓，她便准时端着碎谷粒走到鸡舍前，温柔地呼唤着。看着小鸡们争先恐后欢快啄食的情景，平淡简朴的乡村岁月仿佛在温暖的光晕中悄然定格。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǔmǔ zài nóngjiā xiǎoyuàn lǐ jīngxīn wèiyǎng zhe jǐ zhī máorōngrōng de chújī. Měitiān qīngchén tiān gāng pòxiǎo, tā biàn zhǔnshí duānzhe suì gǔlì zǒudào jīshè qián, wēnróu de hūhuàn zhe. Kànzhe xiǎojī men zhēngxiān-kǒnghòu huānkuài zhuóshí de qíngjǐng, píngdàn jiǎnpǔ de xiāngcūn suìyuè fǎngfú zài wēnnuǎn de guāngyùn zhōng qiǎorán dìnggé.
extended_reading_passages.en: Grandmother lovingly fed several fluffy chicks in the courtyard. Every dawn as skies broke, she walked to the coop with crushed grain, calling tenderly. Watching them peck eagerly, rural simplicity was framed in warm light.
extended_reading_passages.es: La abuela cuidaba con cariño varios polluelos en el patio. Al alba, acudía con grano molido al gallinero llamándolos con ternura; verlos picotear con alegría congelaba la vida campesina en un cuadro entrañable de paz.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在高原濒危藏羚羊繁育中心，志愿者们夜以继日地人工喂养失去母亲的幼崽。他们根据幼兽的生长曲线精准调配特制羊奶，用深沉的人性之爱驱散严寒，生动展现了现代生态工作者对生命尊严的崇高守护。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gāoyuán bīnwēi Zànglíngyáng fányù zhōngxīn, zhìyuànzhě men yèyǐjìrì de réngōng wèiyǎng shīqù mǔqīn de yòuzǎi. Tāmen gēnjù yòushòu de shēngzhǎng qūxiàn jīngzhǔn tiáopèi tèzhì yángnǎi, yòng shēnchén de rénxìng zhī ài qūsàn yánhán, shēngdòng zhǎnshì le xiàndài shēngtài gōngzuòzhě duì shēngmìng zūnyán de chónggāo shǒuhù.
extended_reading_passages.en: At the plateau antelope center, volunteers fed orphaned calves day and night. Formulating milk based on growth curves, their love banished cold, demonstrating modern conservationists' reverence for life's dignity.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el centro de cría del antílope tibetano, voluntarios alimentaban día y noche a crías huérfanas. Ajustando la leche a sus curvas biológicas, su afecto templó el frío, dando fe del respeto sagrado a la vida animal.

meanings_summary.en: group; crowd; flock; herd; pack; swarm; measure word for groups of people or animals
meanings_summary.es: grupo; multitud; rebaño; manada; bandada; enjambre; clasificador de colectivos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A caring shepherd or sovereign (君) guiding a flock of gentle sheep (羊) keeps them united in a herd and group (群).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un pastor prudente (君) que conduce a su dócil rebaño de ovejas (羊) las reúne en manada (群).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient pastoral society, sheep (羊) were gregarious herd animals that grazed collectively. Combining 羊 with 君 (shepherd/ruler) created 群, designating both biological herds and sociopolitical collectives (群众, 群体) requiring wise moral guidance.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'qún' (35). The voice glides cleanly upward from mid pitch to the high register.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 群 is the universal collective classifier for living animate beings (humans, mammals, birds, fish) gathered in numbers.

contrasts.analysis: 群 classifies animate living creatures gathered together socially (一群人, 一群羊), whereas 批 classifies inanimate shipments, batches, or contingents handled collectively (一批货, 第一批学生).
群 is for living moving beings, while 堆 is for stationary heaps or piles of physical clutter (一堆石头, 一堆衣服).
群 denotes an informal, spontaneous swarm or crowd, while 队 designates an organized, disciplined marching line or registered sports team (一支球队, 排队).

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the sheep radical 羊 on the right
Has clothing radical 衤 on the left next to 君
Has cave radical 穴 at top above 君
Has city seal radical 阝 on the right of 君
Has altar 礻 next to 羊 instead of 君

senses.definition_en: used to count gatherings, assemblages, or collections of people, animals, birds, or flying insects
senses.definition_es: clasificador para cuantificar grupos, muchedumbres, rebaños o bandadas de seres vivos
senses.example_phrase: 一群猴子 (a troop of monkeys)

senses.definition_en: a collective flock, gathering, social crowd, or community of individuals
senses.definition_es: multitud, masa, congregación o comunidad de individuos
senses.example_phrase: 群众 (the masses)

example_sentences.hanzi: 傍晚时分，一大群归巢的水鸟从波光粼粼的湖面上空掠过，引得岸边散步的游人纷纷驻足拍照。
example_sentences.pinyin: Bàngwǎn shífēn, yí dà qún guīcháo de shuǐniǎo cóng bōguāng-línlín de húmiàn shàngkōng lüèguò, yǐndé ànbiān sànbù de yóurén fēnfēn zhùzú pāizhào.
example_sentences.en: At dusk, a large flock of returning waterbirds skimmed over the shimmering lake, drawing strolling tourists to halt and take photos.
example_sentences.es: Al anochecer, una gran bandada de aves acuáticas surcó el lago irisado de reflejos, tentando a los paseantes a detenerse y tomar fotos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 寓言中的老人喂养了一大群猴子，猴群因为橡子数量由朝三暮四改为朝四暮三而欢呼雀跃，尽显众生盲从之相。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yùyán zhōng de lǎorén wèiyǎng le yí dà qún hóuzi, hóuqún yīnwèi xiàngzi shùliàng yóu zhāosān-mùsì gǎiwéi zhāosì-mùsān ér huānhū-quèyuè, jìnxiǎn zhòngshēng mángcóng zhī xiàng.
example_sentences.en: The elder in the fable reared a troop of monkeys; rejoicing over acorns shifted from morning-three to morning-four, the herd revealed blind herd mentality.
example_sentences.es: El anciano de la fábula criaba una manada de monos; al trocar las bellotas de tres matutinas a cuatro, los animales saltaron gozosos, mostrando la ceguera de la masa.

collocations.en: a crowd or group of people

idioms.meaning_en: pool collective wisdom and efforts; concerted action
like a crane standing among chickens; stand head and shoulders above
standing out brilliantly above the crowd; preeminent
a herd of dragons without a leader; headless group

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: sheep 羊 being herded together under the watchful command of a sovereign leader 君.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A wise ruler (君) guides a vast grazing flock of gentle sheep (羊) together into a peaceful group (群).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un pastor noble (君) guía a su rebaño de mansas ovejas (羊) reuniéndolas en una comunidad o manada (群).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 广袤无垠的呼伦贝尔大草原上，成群的牛羊宛如朵朵白云，在碧绿的草浪间悠闲游弋。牧马人扬起长鞭，发出一声清脆嘹亮的呼哨，整群骏马便昂首奋蹄，在夕阳的余晖中奔腾如潮，激荡起辽阔天地间的壮美雄风。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Guǎngmào-wúyín de Hūlúnbèi'ěr dà cǎoyuán shàng, chéngqún de niúyáng wǎnrú duǒduǒ báiyún, zài bìlǜ de cǎolàng jiān yōuxián yóuyì. Mùmǎrén yángqǐ chángbiān, fāchū yì shēng qīngcuì liáoliàng de hūshào, zhěng qún jùnmǎ biàn ángshǒu-fèntí, zài xīyáng de yúhuī zhōng bēnténg rú cháo, jīdàng qǐ liáokuò tiāndì jiān de zhuàngměi xióngfēng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Across the boundless Hulunbuir grassland, herds of cattle and sheep drift like white clouds on green waves. The wrangler cracks his whip and whistles; wild horses gallop like a tidal surge in sunset rays, stirring the plains with majesty.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la pradera sin fin de Hulunbuir, los rebaños semejan nubes blancas entre olas verdes. El jinete chasquea el látigo y lanza un silbido; la manada de corceles galopa hacia el ocaso como una marea, henchiendo la estepa de brío salvaje.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代应急治理与大型公共活动保障中，防范高密度人群发生拥挤踩踏是城市公共安全的核心课题。通过部署智能化热力图监测系统，管理部门能够实时掌握人流动态密度，确保人民群众生命财产的绝对安全。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài yīngjí zhìlǐ yǔ dàxíng gōnggòng huódòng bǎozhàng zhōng, fángfàn gāomìdù rénqún fāshēng yōngjǐ cǎità shì chéngshì gōnggòng ānquán de héxīn kètí. Tōngguò bùshǔ zhìnénghuà rèlìtú jiāncè xìtǒng, guǎnlǐ bùmén nénggòu shíshí zhǎngwò rénliú dòngtài mìdù, quèbǎo rénmín qúnzhòng shēngmìng cáichǎn de juéduì ānquán.
extended_reading_passages.en: In emergency governance of large public events, preventing crowd crushes in high-density gatherings is paramount. Deploying heat-map monitoring systems enables administrators to assess flow dynamics in real time, safeguarding public safety.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la protección de concentraciones masivas, prevenir estampidas en aglomeraciones es prioridad urbana. Mediante mapas térmicos de densidad humana, las autoridades monitorizan el flujo en tiempo real, garantizando la seguridad ciudadana.

meanings_summary.en: monkey; agile simian primate
meanings_summary.es: mono; simio ágil; primate de cola prensil o móvil

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An agile wild beast (犭) with the cunning mind of a crowned marquis (侯) leaps through trees as a monkey (猴子).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una criatura del bosque (犭) con el ingenio despierto de un marqués (侯) salta entre lianas como mono (猴子).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese folklore (西游记), the monkey is immortalized by Sun Wukong (美猴王/齐天大圣), embodying rebellious wit, supernatural agility, and defiance of dogmatic authority. In classical Daoism, monkeys symbolize fickle perceptual desires easily appeased by superficial swaps.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by neutral tone: 'hóu zi' (35-neutral). Rise steadily on 'hóu' and pronounce 'zi' lightly without stress.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 猴子 specifically designates a monkey (having a tail), distinct from tail-less apes.

contrasts.analysis: 猴子 denotes monkeys (cercopithecines with tails), whereas 猿 denotes anthropoid apes without tails (gibbons, chimpanzees, orangutans).
猴子 is generic for smaller agile monkeys, while 猩猩 refers specifically to large great apes (chimpanzees, gorillas).
猴子 live largely arboreal lives, while 狒狒 (baboons) are ground-dwelling primates with canine-like muzzles.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has person radical 亻 on the left instead of 犭
Has 亻 with 矢 structure, lacking 犭
Has mouth radical 口 on the left instead of 犭
Has 袁 on the right instead of 侯
Has 星 on the right instead of 侯

senses.definition_en: a small to medium-sized omnivorous primate with agile limbs and typically a long tail, known for its intelligence and dexterity
senses.definition_es: primate omnívoro de tamaño pequeño a mediano, extremidades ágiles y cola, conocido por su viveza e ingenio
senses.example_phrase: 机灵的猴子 (clever monkey)

example_sentences.hanzi: 峨眉山林间的猴子非常调皮，不仅不怕游客，还经常成群结队地拦在路边索要各种坚果零食。
example_sentences.pinyin: Éméishān línjiān de hóuzi fēicháng tiáopí, bùjǐn bú pà yóukè, hái chángcháng chéngqún-jiéduì de lán zài lùbiān suǒyào gèzhǒng jiānguǒ língshí.
example_sentences.en: Monkeys in the forests of Mount Emei are mischievous; not fearing tourists, they often block paths in bands demanding nuts.
example_sentences.es: Los monos del bosque del monte Emei son traviesos; sin temer al caminante, interceptan la senda en tropel pidiendo frutos secos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 庄子寓言里的猴子因为主人朝四暮三的承诺而喜笑颜开，生动讽刺了世人被表象得失轻易愚弄的认知局限。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhuāngzǐ yùyán lǐ de hóuzi yīnwèi zhǔrén zhāosì-mùsān de chéngnuò ér xǐxiào-yánkāi, shēngdòng fěngcì le shìrén bèi biǎoxiàng déshī qīngyì yúnòng de rènzhī júxiàn.
example_sentences.en: Monkeys in Zhuangzi's fable beamed joyously at the offer of four in morning and three at night, satirizing how easily humans are fooled by appearance.
example_sentences.es: Los monos de Zhuangzi sonrieron felices ante el reparto de cuatro bellotas al alba y tres al ocaso, satirizando la ingenuidad ante el espejismo de la ganancia.

collocations.en: monkeys fishing for the moon (futile pursuit)

idioms.meaning_en: kill the chicken to scare the monkey; punish one to warn hundreds
sharp mouth and monkey cheeks; scrawny, treacherous look

idioms.hanzi: 山中无老虎，猴子称大王
idioms.pinyin: shān zhōng wú lǎohǔ, hóuzi chēng dàiwáng
idioms.meaning_en: when tiger is away, monkey claims to be king
a monkey wearing a hat; a scoundrel dressed in dignified robes

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: animal radical 犭 paired with 侯 (marquis / nobleman), meaning the agile crowned marquis of primates.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A cunning wild beast (犭) crowned with the quick intelligence of an ancient marquis (侯) is an agile monkey (猴).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una fiera ágil (犭) dotada de la presteza y noble ingenio de un marqués (侯) encarna al vivaz mono (猴).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Universal nominalizing suffix in spoken Chinese used for animals, fruits, and everyday utensils.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An agile infant (子) waves small arms merrily, mimicking the lively leaps of a young primate.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un infante travieso (子) agita las manos risueño imitando las cabriolas del monito.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 穿行在幽深的热带雨林，密林树冠间时常传来欢快的喧闹声。几只机灵的金丝猴在繁茂的枝桠间敏捷腾跃，宛如林间的金色精灵。它们彼此梳理毛发，分享成熟的野果，在苍翠的大自然中自由自在地繁衍生息。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chuānxíng zài yōushēn de rèdài yǔlín, mìlín shùguān jiān shícháng chuánlái huānkuài de xuānnào shēng. Jǐ zhī jīling de jīnsīhóu zài fánmào de zhīyā jiān mǐnjié téngyuè, wǎnrú línjiān de jīnsè jīnglíng. Tāmen bǐcǐ shūlǐ máofà, fēnxiǎng chéngshú de yěguǒ, zài cāngcuì de dàzìrán zhōng zìyóu-zìzài de fányǎn-shēngxī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Trekking deep rainforests, joyous clamor echoes among canopies. Golden snub-nosed monkeys leap between branches like sprites. Grooming fur and sharing wild fruit, they thrive freely in emerald nature.
extended_reading_passages.es: Cruzando la selva tropical, un bullicio jovial vibra entre las copas. Varios monos dorados saltan ágiles como duendecillos de la floresta; espulgándose y compartiendo frutos, prosperan en libre comunión con la espesura.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在灵长类动物认知科学实验中，猴子展现出了令人惊叹的工具使用能力与初步的抽象推理技巧。研究灵长类动物的行为模式与群体社交结构，对于深入揭示人类大脑早期进化轨迹具有重大的基础理论价值。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài língzhǎnglèi dòngwù rènzhī kēxué shíyàn zhōng, hóuzi zhǎnxiàn chū le lìngrén jīngtàn de gōngjù shǐyòng nénglì yǔ chūbù de chōuxiàng tuīlǐ jìqiǎo. Yánjiū língzhǎnglèi dòngwù de xíngwéi móshì yǔ qúntǐ shèjiāo jiégòu, duìyú shēnrù jiēshì rénlèi dànǎo zǎoqī jìnhuà guǐjì jùyǒu zhòngdà de jīchǔ lǐlùn jiàzhí.
extended_reading_passages.en: In primate cognitive trials, monkeys demonstrate startling tool use and abstract deduction. Investigating primate behavior and group social dynamics holds fundamental theoretical value for deciphering early brain evolution.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los ensayos cognitivos, los simios asombran por su manejo de útiles y deducción abstracta. Estudiar sus hábitos y tramas gregarias arroja luz sobre las sendas evolutivas del cerebro humano.

meanings_summary.en: pet; domestic companion animal; favorite creature kept for pleasure
meanings_summary.es: mascota; animal de compañía; animal doméstico criado por afecto

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A living creature (物) that is pampered, doted upon, and cherished beneath a home roof (宠) is a beloved domestic pet (宠物).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una criatura viva (物) mimada y consentida bajo el amoroso techo del hogar (宠) es una mascota querida (宠物).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In imperial China, 宠 designated royal concubines and favorites receiving imperial favors (恩宠). Combined with 物 (creature/beast), 宠物 originally denoted precious exotic beasts kept in imperial menageries, evolving into the modern term for companion animals.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'chǒng wù' (214-51). Dip low on 'chǒng', then drop with decisive downward stress on 'wù'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 宠物 specifies an animal kept purely for emotional companionship and pleasure, not for economic exploitation.

contrasts.analysis: 宠物 are companion animals kept for affection (dogs, cats, monkeys), whereas 家禽 are domestic poultry kept for meat and eggs (chickens, ducks, geese).
宠物 receive emotional bonds, while 牲畜 are working agricultural livestock (oxen, horses, swine).
宠物 are domesticated and dependent on human feeding, while 野兽 are untamed feral animals living independently in the wilderness.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has cliff radical 广 on the outside instead of 宀
Has earth radical 土 below 龙
Has hand radical 扌 next to 龙
Has 寺 on the right instead of 勿
Has 攵 on the right instead of 勿

senses.definition_en: a domestic or tamed animal kept for companionship, amusement, or affection rather than working utility
senses.definition_es: animal domesticado criado por afecto y solaz familiar más que por utilidad productiva
senses.example_phrase: 饲养宠物 (raise a pet)

example_sentences.hanzi: 随着现代生活水平的提高，越来越多忙碌的都市人选择饲养宠物，以此缓解精神压力并在彼此陪伴中获得慰藉。
example_sentences.pinyin: Suízhe xiàndài shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, yuèláiyuè duō mánglù de dūshìrén xuǎnzé sìyǎng chǒngwù, yǐcǐ huǎnjiě jīngshén yālì bìng zài bǐcǐ péibàn zhōng huòdé wèijiè.
example_sentences.en: With rising living standards, more busy urbanites choose to keep pets to relieve stress and gain solace through mutual companionship.
example_sentences.es: Al mejorar el nivel de vida, más urbanitas crían mascotas para aliviar tensiones y hallar consuelo en la mutua compañía.

example_sentences.hanzi: 寓言中那位老人对猴子的宠爱异于常人，甚至宁愿克扣全家人的开销也要把这些特殊的宠物喂养得白白胖胖。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yùyán zhōng nà wèi lǎorén duì hóuzi de chǒng'ài yìyú-chángrén, shènzhì nìngyuàn kèkòu quánjiā rén de kāixiāo yě yào bǎ zhèxiē tèshū de chǒngwù wèiyǎng de báibái-pàngpàng.
example_sentences.en: The elder's love for his monkeys was extraordinary; he chose to trim family expenses rather than let his special pets go hungry.
example_sentences.es: El anciano de la fábula sentía un apego insólito hacia sus monos; prefería recortar el gasto hogareño antes que desatender a sus mascotas.

idioms.meaning_en: find favor and enjoy high imperial patronage
remain unruffled by neither favor nor disgrace
flattered and overwhelmed by unexpected favor
live in luxury and pampering without toiling

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 寵. Ancient pictogram of a favored dragon 龙 cherished beneath an imperial chamber roof 宀.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Cherishing a wondrous imperial dragon (龙) safe beneath your household roof (宀) means to shower it with affection (宠).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Cobijar a un dragón noble (龙) bajo el seguro techo del hogar (宀) simboliza colmarlo de favores y mimos (宠).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of an ox 牜 of various colors, representing the diverse living creatures of the world.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An ox (牜) standing before waving banners (勿) represents all living creatures and material things on earth (物).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un buey firme (牜) que contempla banderas al viento (勿) encarna la diversidad de criaturas y seres del orbe (物).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 温暖的午后阳光洒满阳台，一只慵懒的猫咪正蜷缩在主人膝头发出惬意的呼噜声。在快节奏的都市生活中，宠物不仅是家庭中不可或缺的萌趣成员，更像是一剂温柔的良药，在无声的依偎中抚平了人们内心的疲惫与孤寂。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wēnnuǎn de wǔhòu yángguāng sǎmǎn yángtái, yì zhī yōnglǎn de māomī zhèng quánsuō zài zhǔrén xītóu fāchū qièyì de hūlūshēng. Zài kuàijièzòu de dūshì shēnghuó zhōng, chǒngwù bùjǐn shì jiātíng zhōng bùkě-huòquē de méngqù chéngyuán, gèng xiàng shì yí jì wēnróu de liángyào, zài wúshēng de yīwēi zhōng fǔpíng le rénmen nèixīn de píbèi yǔ gūjì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Warm afternoon sunlight dapples the balcony as a languid cat curls on its owner's lap purring. In urban life, pets are not only cheerful companions, but gentle medicine whose silent snuggling smooths away fatigue.
extended_reading_passages.es: El sol tibio baña el balcón mientras un gato perezoso ronronea en el regazo de su amo. En la vida urbana, las mascotas son bálsamo tierno que con su apego mudo cura el cansancio y la soledad del alma.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 伴随现代社会老龄化与独居人口比例的持续上升，“宠物经济”正在演变为具有巨大发展潜力的庞大消费新赛道。涵盖高品质健康粮、智能看护设备与宠物医疗保险在内的新型服务业态，映射出当代人对精神情感陪伴的强烈渴望。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bànsuí xiàndài shèhuì lǎolínghuà yǔ dújū rénkǒu bǐlì de chíxù shàngshēng, 'chǒngwù jīngjì' zhèngzài yǎnbiàn wéi jùyǒu jùdà fāzhǎn qiánlì de pángdà xiāofèi xīn sàidào. Hángài gāopǐnzhì jiànkāngliáng, zhìnéng kānhù shèbèi yǔ chǒngwù yīliáo bǎoxiǎn zài nèi de xīnxíng fúwù yètài, yìngshè chū dāngdàirén duì jīngshén qínggǎn péibàn de qiángliè kěwàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: With aging populations and single living, the 'pet economy' has evolved into a vast consumption track. High-grade foods, smart cameras, and pet insurance reflect modern people's intense yearning for emotional companionship.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el envejecimiento y la vida solitaria, la 'economía de mascotas' florece como un mercado pujante. Piensos de gama alta, collares inteligentes y seguros veterinarios reflejan el vivo anhelo de calor afectivo en las ciudades.

meanings_summary.en: to get along with; to live together; to interact and associate with one another
meanings_summary.es: convivir; llevarse con; relacionarse; tratarse mutuamente en el día a día

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Gazing mutually into each other's eyes (相) while residing beneath the same roof (处) means to live and get along together (相处).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Mirarse con afecto recíproco (相) mientras se comparte morada (处) es convivir y tratarse (相处).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese social ethics, 相 (mutuality) and 处 (dwelling peacefully) form the foundation of relational harmony. Daoism expands 相处 to human-nature harmony (人与自然和谐相处), while Confucianism anchors it in domestic filial harmony (家庭和睦相处).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone followed by dipping 3rd tone: 'xiāng chǔ' (55-214). (Note 4th tone 'chù' in nouns meaning place: 处所, 到处).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 相处 emphasizes ongoing interpersonal interaction, mutual adjustment, and living together.

contrasts.analysis: 相处 focuses on personal emotional and social cohabitation (和睦相处), whereas 合作 focuses on functional, transactional synergy to achieve a joint project.
交往 is broader, describing general external social networking or dating, while 相处 requires continuous closer contact over time.
共处 is formal and geopolitical (和平共处五项原则), while 相处 is intimate and psychological between individuals.

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: wing of a house; side room

senses.definition_en: to live, work, interact, or associate with another person or entity over time in mutual social contact
senses.definition_es: convivir, tratarse o mantener relación cotidiana y prolongada con alguien
senses.example_phrase: 和睦相处 (live together in harmony)

example_sentences.hanzi: 老人与这群猴子在朝夕相处中培养出了深厚的默契，彼此仅仅通过眼神与叫声便能心领神会。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén yǔ zhè qún hóuzi zài zhāoxī-xiāngchǔ zhōng péiyǎng chū le shēnhòu de mòqì, bǐcǐ jǐnjǐn tōngguò yǎnshén yǔ jiàoshēng biàn néng xīnlǐng-shénhuì.
example_sentences.en: In living together day and night, the elder and the monkeys cultivated tacit rapport, understanding one another through glances and calls.
example_sentences.es: En su diaria convivencia, el anciano y los monos forjaron una compenetración honda, entendiéndose a la perfección solo con miradas y gemidos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 人与人之间若想长久和谐相处，关键在于彼此懂得尊重差异、换位思考，并在原则问题上保持真诚与宽容。
example_sentences.pinyin: Rén yǔ rén zhījiān ruò xiǎng chángjiǔ héxié xiāngchǔ, guānjiàn zàiyú bǐcǐ dǒngdé zūnzhòng chāyì, huànwèi-sīkǎo, bìng zài yuánzé wèntí shàng bǎochí zhēnchéng yǔ kuānróng.
example_sentences.en: For people to get along harmoniously over time, the key lies in respecting differences, empathizing, and maintaining sincerity.
example_sentences.es: Para que las personas convivan en armonía duradera, la clave radica en respetar las discrepancias, ponerse en el lugar del otro y practicar la tolerancia.

character_decomposition.meaning_es: mutuo; recíproco; el uno al otro
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram of an eye 目 carefully inspecting timber 木 from close range, evolving into mutual face-to-face looking.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two eyes (目) gazing closely across the green leaves of a tree (木) at one another in mutual fellowship (相).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ojos atentos (目) que cruzan su mirada a través de las ramas de un árbol (木) en recíproca cercanía (相).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 處. Ancient pictogram of a person reclining upon a low seat 几, resting and settling down to dwell.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Stepping forward slowly (夂) and finding an auspicious spot (卜) to sit down, reside, and live peacefully (处).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Caminar sin prisa (夂) hasta dar con un rincón propicio (卜) donde reposar y convivir en paz (处).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 茫茫人海中相遇是缘分，而能够长久相处更是一种深沉的智慧。真正的知己不在于形影不离的喧闹，而在于即使相对无言也能心意相通。在彼此尊重的相处中，我们照见了真实的自我，也收获了岁月馈赠的深情。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mángmáng rénhǎi zhōng xiāngyù shì yuánfèn, ér nénggòu chángjiǔ xiāngchǔ gèng shì yì zhǒng shēnchén de zhìhuì. Zhēnzhèng de zhījǐ búzàiyú xíngyǐng-bùlí de xuānnào, ér zàiyú jíshǐ xiāngduì-wúyán yě néng xīnyì-xiāngtōng. Zài bǐcǐ zūnzhòng de xiāngchǔ zhōng, wǒmen zhàojiàn le zhēnshí de zìwǒ, yě shōuhuò le suìyuè kuìzèng de shēnqíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Meeting in vast seas of people is destiny, but getting along long-term is wisdom. Soulmates need not cling in noisy company; even in silence they commune. Respectful interaction mirrors true selfhood and harvests affection.
extended_reading_passages.es: Coincidir en el mar humano es fortuna, pero convivir con armonía es alta sabiduría. Los amigos del alma no precisan cercanía bulliciosa; su silencio es diálogo. En el trato respetuoso nos descubrimos a nosotros mismos y hallamos amor verdadero.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在构建人类命运共同体的宏大时代图景中，不同文明之间的包容相处至关重要。唯有彻底摒弃零和博弈与傲慢偏见，推动不同社会制度在平等互鉴中和平相处，才能汇聚起应对全人类共同挑战的磅礴合力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gòujiàn rénlèi mìngyùn gòngtóngtǐ de hóngdà shídài tújǐng zhōng, bùtóng wénmíng zhījiān de bāoróng xiāngchǔ zhìguān-zhòngyào. Wéiyǒu chèdǐ bìngqì línghé bóyì yǔ àomàn piānjiàn, tuīdòng bùtóng shèhuì zhìdù zài píngděng hùjiàn zhōng hépíng xiāngchǔ, cáinéng huìjù qǐ yìngduì quán rénlèi gòngtóng tiǎozhàn de pángbó hélì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In building a human destiny community, inclusive coexistence among civilizations is paramount. Rooting out zero-sum bias and fostering mutual learning allows diverse societies to coexist peacefully, uniting against global perils.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al erigir una comunidad de destino compartido, la convivencia integradora entre civilizaciones es capital. Desterrando pugnas estériles y promoviendo el respeto entre sistemas diversos, la humanidad concitará voluntades firmes ante los retos del porvenir.

meanings_summary.en: each other; one another; mutually; both parties; (polite) the same to you
meanings_summary.es: el uno al otro; mutuamente; entrambos; ambas partes; (cortesía) igualmente

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Linking what is situated far over there (彼) with what is planted right here (此) encompasses both parties and each other (彼此).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Conectar lo que está allá a lo lejos (彼) con lo que reposa aquí a los pies (此) abarca a ambas partes el uno con el otro (彼此).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient classical grammar, 彼 (that / the other) and 此 (this / oneself) formed a spatial deictic binary. Fused together, 彼此 transcended polar opposition into a reciprocal relational pronoun uniting two parties in intersubjective dialogue.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual dipping 3rd tones: 'bǐ cǐ'. Under standard Mandarin sandhi, the first 3rd tone shifts to rising 2nd tone: 'bí cǐ' (35-214).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 彼此 is a reciprocal pronoun referring to both interacting sides in a relationship, with an elevated literary register compared to 互相.

contrasts.analysis: 互相 is purely an adverb that must directly precede a verb (互相帮助), whereas 彼此 is a noun/pronoun that can stand as subject, object, or modifier (彼此的心愿, 增进彼此的了解).
双方 is formal, legal, and institutional (合同双方), whereas 彼此 is psychological, philosophical, and personal.
相互 is an adverbial synonym of 互相, while 彼此 can function as a standalone colloquial response ('彼此彼此!').

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过漫长时间的朝夕相伴，老人与猴群彼此建立起了无需语言翻译的深厚心灵默契。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò màncháng shíjiān de zhāoxī-xiāngbàn, lǎorén yǔ hóuqún bǐcǐ jiànlì qǐ le wúxū yǔyán fānyì de shēnhòu xīnlíng mòqì.
example_sentences.en: Through long days and nights together, the elder and the monkey troop built tacit mutual rapport requiring no linguistic translation.
example_sentences.es: A través de una prolongada convivencia diaria, el anciano y la manada forjaron una honda compenetración mutua que prescindía de palabras.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对全球性气候危机的共同考验，世界各国应当放下地缘政治分歧，在彼此尊重的基础上深化互利合作。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì quánqiúxìng qìhòu wēijī de gòngtóng kǎoyàn, shìjiè gèguó yīngdāng fàngxià dìyuán-zhèngzhì fēnqí, zài bǐcǐ zūnzhòng de jīchǔ shàng shēnhuà hùlì hézuò.
example_sentences.en: Facing the common test of climate crises, nations should set aside geopolitics and deepen cooperation on mutual respect.
example_sentences.es: Ante el reto común de la crisis climática, los países deben aparcar discrepancias geopolíticas y ahondar su cooperación sobre el respeto mutuo.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: step radical 彳 indicating walking into the distance, paired with 皮. Means 'that distant other'.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Taking measured footsteps along the road (彳) toward that distant, far-off horizon points toward the other (彼).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Avanzar con pasos medidos (彳) hacia el horizonte distante señala aquello lejano y al otro (彼).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram of a person 匕 standing with foot 止 firmly planted right here on the ground, meaning 'this place / here'.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person pauses and plants their foot firmly on the earth (止) right here in this present spot (此).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona planta con firmeza la planta del pie (止) justo en este lugar y en este instante (此).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在漫长的人生旅途中，能够遇到一位彼此理解、彼此欣赏的知心挚友，实乃生命莫大的幸运。真正的深情从来不需要繁复的言辞修饰，只要目光交汇，彼此心底的默契便如春雨般润物无声，温暖着漫漫岁月。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài màncháng de rénshēng lǚtú zhōng, nénggòu yùdào yí wèi bǐcǐ lǐjiě, bǐcǐ xīnshǎng de zhīxīn zhìyǒu, shí nǎi shēngmìng mòdà de xìngyùn. Zhēnzhèng de shēnqíng cónglái bù xūyào fánfù de yáncí xiūshì, zhǐyào mùguāng jiāohuì, bǐcǐ xīndǐ de mòqì biàn rú chūnyǔ bān rùnwù-wúshēng, wēnnuǎn zhe mànmàn suìyuè.
extended_reading_passages.en: On the long journey of life, encountering a soulmate who mutually understands and appreciates you is supreme fortune. True devotion requires no florid rhetoric; when eyes meet, tacit harmony moistens the heart like gentle spring rain.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la andadura de la vida, hallar a alguien con quien entenderse y apreciarse mutuamente es ventura suma. El afecto auténtico prescinde de artificios; al cruzarse las miradas, la complicidad cala en el alma como lluvia primaveral templando el tiempo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在推动构建新型国际关系的历史征程中，相互尊重与彼此关照核心利益是国与国之间持久和平交往的黄金法则。唯有打破霸权主义与双重标准，推动各大国在彼此平等的基础上携手合作，才能实现全球治理的稳定繁荣。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài tuīdòng gòujiàn xīnxíng guójì guānxì de lìshǐ zhēngchéng zhōng, xiānghù zūnzhòng yǔ bǐcǐ guānzhào héxīn lìyì shì guó yǔ guó zhījiān chǐjiǔ hépíng jiāowǎng de huángjīn fǎzé. Wéiyǒu dǎpò bàquánzhǔyì yǔ shuāngchóng biāozhǔn, tuīdòng gè dàguó zài bǐcǐ píngděng de jīchǔ shàng xiéshǒu hézuò, cáinéng shíxiàn quánqiú zhìlǐ de wěndìng fánróng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In building new international relations, mutual respect and accommodating vital interests is the golden rule of peace. Dismantling hegemony and promoting equal cooperation fosters stability and prosperity in global governance.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la forja de unas relaciones internacionales renovadas, el respeto mutuo a los intereses vitales es la regla áurea de la paz. Desterrando hegemonismos y aunando voluntades en pie de igualdad, se alcanzará la estabilidad en la gobernanza global.

meanings_summary.en: facial expression; look; demeanor expressing emotion; emoji
meanings_summary.es: expresión facial; semblante; gesto emotivo; ademán del rostro; emoticono

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When the inner feelings of the heart (情) manifest upon the outer surface of the face (表), they create a visible facial expression (表情).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando los afectos del corazón (情) afloran al exterior del semblante (表), dibujan la expresión facial (表情).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese poetics, 情 (innate feelings) must be externalized through 表 (manifestation / appearance). The face acts as an emotional mirror (相由心生), where subtle micro-movements of brows and eyes convey non-verbal meaning across species barriers.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'biǎo qíng' (214-35). Dip low on 'biǎo', then glide upward smoothly on 'qíng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 表情 focuses on the dynamic, transient facial configuration conveying immediate mood or reaction.

contrasts.analysis: 表情 refers strictly to localized physical muscle movements of the face (眉毛, 嘴角), whereas 神情 encompasses the broader, lingering spiritual demeanor and aura of the eyes and posture (神情落寞).
脸色 refers either to skin complexion (脸色苍白) or to cold, disapproving social attitudes (看人脸色), while 表情 is purely emotional configuration.
表情 is of the face, while 动作 involves limbs, torso, and bodily physical movements.

senses.example_phrase: 丰富的表情 (rich facial expressions)

example_sentences.hanzi: 看到老人把橡子改成早上四颗、晚上三颗，猴子们脸上立刻露出了心满意足的滑稽表情。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kàndào lǎorén bǎ xiàngzi gǎichéng zǎoshang sì kē, wǎnshang sān kē, hóuzi men liǎnshàng lìkè lùchū le xīnmǎn-yìzú de huájī biǎoqíng.
example_sentences.en: Seeing the elder change acorns to four in morning and three at night, monkeys instantly showed comical, satisfied expressions on their faces.
example_sentences.es: Al ver que el anciano cambiaba las bellotas a cuatro por la mañana y tres por la tarde, los monos mudaron el gesto a una mueca cómica de satisfacción.

example_sentences.hanzi: 舞台剧演员不仅台词功底极其深厚，更善于通过细腻入微的面部表情将人物内心的剧烈挣扎演绎得淋漓尽致。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wǔtáijù yǎnyuán bùjǐn táicí gōngdǐ jíqí shēnhòu, gèng shànyú tōngguò xìnì-rùwēi de miànbù biǎoqíng jiāng rénwù nèixīn de jùliè zhèngzhá yǎnyì de línlí-jìnzhì.
example_sentences.en: Stage actors not only command dialogue delivery, but master subtle facial expressions to vividly convey characters' internal struggles.
example_sentences.es: Los actores teatrales dominan la declamación y se valen de sutiles expresiones faciales para retratar con desgarro la lucha anímica del personaje.
