Has mound/ear radical 阝 on the left instead of water 氵
Contains water radical 氵 before 匋
Has water radical 氵 on the left of 气
Has 分 inside 气 at bottom

senses.definition_en: full of energetic mischief, restless romp, and minor disobedience typical of spirited young children
senses.definition_es: lleno de energía desbordante y propensión a corretear, jugar y cometer pequeñas diabluras infantiles
senses.example_phrase: 淘气包 (little troublemaker / naughty imp)

example_sentences.hanzi: 那个淘气的小男孩整天爬树抓知了，衣服上沾满了泥巴，却依然笑得格外开心。
example_sentences.pinyin: Nàge táoqì de xiǎo nánhái zhěngtiān páshù zhuā zhīliǎo, yīfu shang zhānmǎn le níbā, què yīrán xiào de géwài kāixīn.
example_sentences.en: That naughty little boy climbed trees catching cicadas all day, clothes covered in mud, yet beamed with utmost delight.
example_sentences.es: Aquel chiquillo revoltoso se pasaba el día trepando a los árboles cazando cigarras con la ropa embarrada, pero riendo a carcajadas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对精力极其充沛且淘气好动的低龄学童，教师更需要具备充足的耐心与善于发现闪光点的教育智慧。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jīnglì jíqí chōngpèi qiě táoqì hàodòng de dīlíng xuétóng, jiàoshī gèng xūyào jùbèi chōngzú de nàixīn yǔ shànyú fāxiàn shǎnguāngdiǎn de jiàoyù zhìhuì.
example_sentences.en: Facing energetic, mischievous young schoolchildren, teachers need abundant patience and educational wisdom to spot their unique sparks.
example_sentences.es: Ante alumnos de corta edad rebosantes de brío y travesura, los maestros precisan paciencia infinita y agudeza para descubrir sus talentos.

idioms.meaning_en: doughty as a dragon and lively as a tiger; brimming with vitality
leap up and down; hop about restlessly
bouncing and skipping; full of life and friskiness
leap and romp with joy; frisk about happily

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where water radical 氵 evokes swirling river water panning gravel, and 匋 supplies sound.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Water swirling energetically (氵) inside an earthen basin (匋) to pan rice depicts turbulent, restless splashing activity (淘).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El agua que se agita briosa (氵) dentro de la vasija de barro (匋) para lavar el grano evoca el movimiento revoltoso e incesante (淘).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 氣. Ancient pictograph showing three swirling layers of atmospheric vapor and mist rising effortlessly into the skies.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Wisps of warm rising vapor and atmospheric energy (气) express boundless vitality, breath, and restless spirit (气).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Espirales de vapor y aire cálido (气) que ascienden con ligereza expresan el aliento vital y el ánimo revoltoso (气).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 乡村夏日的池塘边总能听见淘气孩童的欢叫声。他们头顶宽大的荷叶，光着脚丫踩在松软的淤泥里捉小鱼小虾，哪怕摔成一个个小泥人，也乐得手舞足蹈。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiāngcūn xiàrì de chítáng biān zǒng néng tīngjiàn táoqì háitóng de huānjiàoshēng. Tāmen tóudǐng kuāndà de héyè, guāngzhe jiǎoyā cǎi zài sōngruǎn de yūní lǐ zhuō xiǎoyú xiǎoxiā, nǎpà shuāi chéng yí gè gè xiǎonírén, yě lè de shǒuwǔ-zúdǎo.
extended_reading_passages.en: By the rural summer pond, one always hears naughty kids cheering. Wearing lotus leaves on their heads and treading mud for fish, even falling into muddy imps brings wild dance.
extended_reading_passages.es: Junto al estanque rural en verano siempre resuenan los gritos de chiquillos revoltosos. Con hojas de loto por sombrero buscan renacuajos en el fango, brincando de gozo embadurnados de lodo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 儿童心理学研究表明，适度的淘气是幼童大脑认知发育与空间探索欲旺盛的健康征兆。宽容理解孩子的探索天性，才能让他们在充满安全感与欢笑的环境中茁壮成长。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Értóng xīnlǐxué yánjiū biǎomíng, shìdù de táoqì shì yòutóng dànǎo rènzhī fāyù yǔ kōngjiān tànsuǒyù wàngshèng de jiànkāng zhēngzhào. Kuānróng lǐjiě háizi de tànsuǒ tiānxìng, cáinéng ràng tāmen zài chōngmǎn ānquángǎn yǔ huánxiào de huánjìng zhōng zhuózhuàng chéngzhǎng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Child psychology reveals moderate naughtiness is a healthy sign of cognitive growth and spatial curiosity. Embracing this instinct helps children thrive in safe, joyful settings.
extended_reading_passages.es: La psicología infantil constata que cierta inquietud traviesa es indicio de vigor mental y afán exploratorio. Comprender este instinto permite que los niños maduren seguros entre risas.

meanings_summary.en: acorn; oak nut; fruit of the oak tree
meanings_summary.es: bellota; fruto del roble o de la encina

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The fruit of the mighty elephant-like oak tree (橡) packed into small round nuts (子) produces nutritious acorns (橡子).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El fruto del roble corpulento como elefante (橡) condensado en pequeña semilla dura (子) es la bellota (橡子).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In the Taoist masterwork Zhuangzi (齐物论), acorns (芧/橡子) are the central narrative device of the keeper and monkeys (狙公赋芧). The parable illustrates cognitive blindness: people rejoice or despair over superficial rearrangements that leave underlying totals unchanged.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by neutral tone: 'xiàng zi' (51-neutral). Drop sharply on 'xiàng' and pronounce 'zi' lightly and briefly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 橡子 specifically refers to the wild nut or acorn yielded by oak trees (栎属植物果实).

contrasts.analysis: 橡子 is an oak acorn with a smooth shell and woody cupule, while 板栗 is a sweet edible chestnut encased in a sharp, spiny burr.
橡子 grows on deciduous oak trees, whereas 松子 is the pine nut harvest from coniferous pine cones.
橡子 is the specific botanical species of nut, while 果实 is the broad general term for any biological fruit or yield.

senses.definition_en: the oval, smooth-shelled nut of the oak tree, enclosed at the base in a woody cupule, eaten by squirrels, monkeys, and wild boars
senses.definition_es: fruto ovalado del roble o encina con corteza dura y cúpula leñosa, alimento de ardillas, monos y jabalíes
senses.example_phrase: 捡橡子 (gather acorns / pick up acorns)

example_sentences.hanzi: 深秋时节，几只机灵的灰松鼠忙着在栎树林里穿梭，把掉落在落叶堆里的橡子悄悄埋进土里以备过冬。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shēnqiū shíjié, jǐ zhī jīling de huīsōngshǔ máng zhe zài lìshùlín lǐ chuānsuō, bǎ diàoluò zài luòyèduī lǐ de xiàngzi qiāoqiāo mái jìn tǔ lǐ yǐ bèi guòdōng.
example_sentences.en: In late autumn, several agile squirrels scurried through the oak grove, busily burying fallen acorns beneath leaf piles for winter.
example_sentences.es: En el otoño tardío, varias ardillas correteaban por el robledal enterrando con premura las bellotas caídas entre la hojarasca para pasar el invierno.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在庄子所记载的“朝三暮四”经典寓言中，养猴老人正是巧妙利用早晚分发橡子数量的变化，平息了群猴的愤怒。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài Zhuāngzǐ suǒ jìzǎi de "zhāosān-mùsì" jīngdiǎn yùyán zhōng, yǎnghóu lǎorén zhèngshì qiǎomiào lìyòng zǎowǎn fēnfā xiàngzi shùliàng de biànhuà, píngxī le qúnhóu de fènnù.
example_sentences.en: In the classic Zhuangzi fable "Zhao San Mu Si", the monkey keeper subtly adjusted the morning and evening acorn distribution to pacify the troupe.
example_sentences.es: En la célebre fábula del Zhuangzi sobre "tres por la mañana y cuatro por la noche", el anciano calmó a los monos cambiando el reparto diario de bellotas.

collocations.en: gather acorns; pick up oak nuts
acorns scattered all over the ground
feed with acorns; provide acorns as forage

idioms.meaning_en: three in the morning and four at night; fickle; deceptive manipulation
the only surviving fruit; sole remaining relic
pull up seedlings to help them grow; spoil things through impatience
every bush and tree looks like an enemy soldier; state of extreme panic

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where wood radical 木 denotes an arboreal oak tree, and 象 supplies the phonetic sound.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A magnificent ancient forest tree (木) standing strong and sturdy like a giant elephant (象) is the mighty oak (橡).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un árbol robusto del bosque (木) corpulento y majestuoso como un gran elefante (象) es el roble que da bellotas (橡).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of an infant swaddled with legs wrapped and arms reaching out, extended to mean seeds and small round nuts.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An infant reaching out with tiny hands, extended metaphorically to any small, hard, precious seed or nut (子).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un tierno infante que extiende sus bracitos, cuyo contorno pasó a nombrar los frutos redondos y semillas menudas (子).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 漫步在金秋的古树林间，微风拂过，头顶不时传来成熟橡子簌簌坠地的轻响。林间的小鹿与野兔寻声而至，低头在厚厚的落叶里刨食这大自然慷慨赐予的越冬美味。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mànbù zài jīnqiū de gǔshùlín jiān, wēifēng fúguò, tóudǐng bùshí chuánlái chéngshú xiàngzi sùsù zhuìdì de qīngxiǎng. Línjiān de xiǎolù yǔ yětù xúnshēng ér zhì, dītóu zài hòuhòu de luòyè lǐ páoshí zhè dàzìrán kāngkǎi cìyǔ de yuèdōng měiwèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Strolling through ancient autumn woods, ripe acorns patter onto the ground as the breeze stirs. Woodland deer and hares gather to forage for nature's bountiful winter treats.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al pasear por el hayedo otoñal, las bellotas maduras caen con leve crujido entre las hojas mecidas por el viento. Corzos y liebres acuden a desenterrar este generoso manjar invernal.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: “狙公赋芧”的寓言流传两千余载，小小的橡子因而成为中国哲学史上最富启发性的隐喻符号。它警醒世人切勿被外在形式与瞬时顺序的表象所惑，而应洞见事物内在的等同与统一。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: "Jūgōng fùyù" de yùyán liúchuán liǎngqiān yú zǎi, xiǎoxiǎo de xiàngzi yīn'ér chéngwéi Zhōngguó zhéxué shǐshàng zuì fù qǐfāxìng de yǐnyù fúhào. Tā jǐngxǐng shìrén qièwù bèi wàizài xíngshì yǔ shùnshí shùnxù de biǎoxiàng suǒ huò, ér yīng dòngjiàn shìwù nèizài de děngtóng yǔ tǒngyī.
extended_reading_passages.en: The acorn fable has endured for over two millennia, making the humble oak nut a potent philosophical metaphor. It cautions us not to be duped by superficial orders, but to perceive underlying unity.
extended_reading_passages.es: La parábola de las bellotas perdura tras dos milenios como símbolo filosófico. Nos alerta contra el engaño de las apariencias y el orden superficial, exhortándonos a percibir la equidad esencial.

meanings_summary.en: fruit (botanical); harvest; gains; fruits of labor; positive results
meanings_summary.es: fruto; fruto del trabajo; cosecha; ganancias; logros conseguidos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Ripe fruit hanging from orchard branches (果) filled with solid, substantial nutrition under the roof (实) constitutes a fruitful harvest (果实).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La fruta madurada en las ramas del árbol (果) colmada de pulpa sólida y sustanciosa (实) representa el fruto cosechado (果实).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese philosophical tradition, 'huā' (花 - flower/appearance) and 'shí' (实 - fruit/substance) form an essential dialectic. Superficial brilliance without tangible outcome is dismissed as 'huā ér bù shí' (华而不实 - flowery but barren).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'guǒ shí' (214-35). Dip low on 'guǒ' then lift smoothly and cleanly on 'shí'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 果实 denotes both literal botanical fruits and metaphoric achievements born of effort.

contrasts.analysis: 水果 refers exclusively to juicy, sweet culinary fruits eaten fresh by people (apples, oranges), whereas 果实 includes all botanical fruits (acorns, pods) and abstract achievements.
成果 is strictly abstract and refers to positive results or achievements (科研成果), while 果实 can be both physical plant fruits and metaphorical rewards.
果实 typically carries a positive or natural connotation (fruits of labor), whereas 后果 almost always denotes negative or disastrous consequences (严重后果).

senses.definition_en: the seed-bearing structure in flowering plants formed from the ovary after flowering; biological fruit
senses.definition_es: estructura vegetal que contiene y protege las semillas formada tras la floración; fruta o fruto botánico
senses.example_phrase: 结出果实 (bear fruit / produce fruits)

senses.definition_en: the positive outcome, achievement, or reward obtained through prolonged effort, labor, or struggle
senses.definition_es: resultado positivo, recompensa o logro alcanzado tras un arduo esfuerzo prolongado
senses.example_phrase: 劳动果实 (fruits of labor / fruits of hard work)

example_sentences.hanzi: 金秋十月，漫山遍野的苹果园里硕果累累，红彤彤的果实压弯了枝头，散发着诱人的果香。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīnqiū shíyuè, mànshān-biànyě de píngguǒyuán lǐ shuòguǒ-léiléi, hóngtōngtōng de guǒshí yāwān le zhītóu, sànfà zhe yòurén de guǒxiāng.
example_sentences.en: In golden October, apple orchards across the hills hung heavy with fruit; crimson apples bent the branches, giving off sweet fragrance.
example_sentences.es: En octubre dorado, los manzanos que cubren las lomas rebosan de cosechas; sus frutos rojizos comban las ramas despidiendo un aroma embriagador.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过科研团队十余年的潜心攻关，这项填补国内技术空白的重大科技成果终于开花结果，结出了丰硕的产业化果实。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò kēyán tuánduì shí yú nián de qiǎnxīn gōngguān, zhè xiàng tiánbǔ guónèi jìshù kòngbái de zhòngdà kējì chéngguǒ zhōngyú kāihuā-jiéguǒ, jiéchū le fēngshuò de chǎnyèhuà guǒshí.
example_sentences.en: After a decade of devoted research, this breakthrough bridging domestic gaps finally bore fruit, yielding rich industrial gains.
example_sentences.es: Tras diez años de afán investigador, este hito tecnológico que colma un vacío nacional floreció al fin, rindiendo fecundos frutos industriales.

collocations.en: fruits of labor; reward of honest work
laden with abundant fruit; heavy harvests
taste the fruits; savor the outcomes

idioms.meaning_en: laden with abundant fruits; huge achievements
blossom and bear fruit; yield fruitful results
seek truth from facts; be realistic and pragmatic
the only surviving fruit; rare survivor

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph depicting round, ripe fruit 田 growing atop the leafy branches of a tree 木.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: High atop the branches of a tree (木), round, ripe berries (田) ripen in sunshine, defining delicious botanical fruit (果).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: En lo alto de la copa de un árbol (木), frutos redondos y maduros (田) se calientan al sol, dando origen a la fruta (果).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 實. Ancient character showing a house 宀 filled to capacity with strings of cowrie shells and grain, signifying solidity and fullness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Beneath the home roof (宀), tangible solid wealth and stored harvests accumulate, proving genuine reality and ripe fruit (实).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el techo del hogar (宀) se colman las despensas de grano y bienes sólidos, signo de autenticidad y sazón cumplida (实).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 深秋的晨曦穿透薄雾，照耀在山坡上的百年古柿树上。红艳饱满的柿子宛如一盏盏喜庆的小灯笼挂满枝头，这些饱经风霜的果实，正是大自然对四季耕耘最甜美的馈赠。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēnqiū de chénxī chuāntòu báowù, zhàoyào zài shānpō shàng de bǎinián gǔshìshù shàng. Hóngyàn bǎomǎn de shìzi wǎnrú yìzhǎnzhǎn xǐqìng de xiǎodēnglong guàmǎn zhītóu, zhèxiē bǎojīng-fēngshuāng de guǒshí, zhèngshì dàzìrán duì sìjì gēngyún zuì tiánměi de kuìzèng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Autumn morning light pierces the mist onto an ancient persimmon tree on the hillside. Plump red fruits hang like festive lanterns; weather-beaten fruits are nature's sweetest gift to season's toil.
extended_reading_passages.es: La aurora otoñal descorre la bruma alumbrando un viejo caqui en la ladera. Sus frutos carmesíes cuelgan como farolillos festivos, rindiendo el tributo más dulce de la naturaleza al afán del año.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 任何伟大的学术创见或技术革新，都不是一蹴而就的灵感闪现，而是科研人员在寂寞中数十年如一日甘坐冷板凳结出的果实。尊重劳动、保护创新，正是社会文明不断前行的动力源泉。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Rènhé wěidà de xuéshù chuàngjiàn huò jìshù géxīn, dōubúshì yícù'érjiù de línggǎn shǎnxiàn, érshì kēyán rényuán zài jìmò zhōng shùshí nián rùyírì gān zuò lěngbǎndèng jiéchū de guǒshí. Zūnzhòng láodòng, bǎohù chuàngxīn, zhèngshì shèhuì wénmíng bùduàn qiánxíng de dònglì yuánquán.
extended_reading_passages.en: Great academic insights or technological innovations are never overnight flashes, but fruits of researchers braving decades of quiet toil. Honoring labor and protecting innovation drives human civilization forward.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las grandes creaciones científicas no brotan de un destello fugaz, sino de decenios de silencioso estudio. Honrar el trabajo y tutelar las ideas constituye el motor que hace avanzar a las sociedades.

meanings_summary.en: insufficient; inadequate; lacking; deficient; less than; shortcoming
meanings_summary.es: insuficiente; escaso; deficiente; carente; no llegar a; defecto

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The negative particle (不) negating solid, grounded sufficiency (足) defines being insufficient, deficient, or lacking (不足).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La negación categórica (不) aplicada a la suficiencia y firmeza del pie (足) describe lo que es insuficiente o escaso (不足).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Daoist philosophy (老子: 知足常乐 - one who knows contentment is always happy), 'zú' represents existential completion. The Book of Rites (礼记: 学然后知不足) teaches that 'only after studying does one realize one's deficiency', framing awareness of 不足 as the gateway to wisdom.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'bù zú' (51-35). 'bù' retains its original 4th tone before 2nd-tone 'zú'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 不足 indicates failing to reach a required standard, quantity, threshold, or degree.

contrasts.analysis: 不足 means the quantity present is inadequate or below requirement (睡眠不足), whereas 缺少 means something is completely missing or absent (缺少工具).
不足 can describe both concrete deficits and minor flaws, while 缺乏 describes severe, chronic, or abstract deficiencies (缺乏信心, 缺乏维生素).
不足 refers to deficiencies or areas where capacity is inadequate, whereas 缺点 refers to specific character flaws, behavioral defects, or system bugs.

senses.definition_en: not enough in quantity, capacity, intensity, or degree; lacking sufficiency
senses.definition_es: que no alcanza la cantidad, intensidad o grado indispensable; escaso o deficitario
senses.example_phrase: 经验不足 (lack of experience / insufficient experience)

senses.definition_en: a defect, weakness, shortcoming, or area needing improvement
senses.definition_es: defecto, carencia o limitación susceptible de mejora
senses.example_phrase: 弥补不足 (make up for deficiencies / overcome shortcomings)

senses.definition_en: less than a specified number, amount, or duration
senses.definition_es: que no alcanza o no llega a cierta cifra, cantidad o plazo
senses.example_phrase: 不足三成 (less than thirty percent)

example_sentences.hanzi: 由于前期准备工作严重不足，加上突发恶劣暴风雨，原本周密制定的户外登山计划被迫中途取消。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú qiánqī zhǔnbèi gōngzuò yánzhòng bùzú, jiāshàng tūfā èliè bàofēngyǔ, yuánběn zhōumì zhìdìng de hùwài dēngshān jìhuà bèipò zhōngtú qǔxiāo.
example_sentences.en: Due to severe inadequacy in preliminary preparations combined with sudden storms, the meticulously planned mountaineering trip had to be canceled.
example_sentences.es: Debido a una preparación previa seriamente deficiente y a una tempestad imprevista, la excursión de alta montaña hubo de cancelarse a mitad de camino.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在年终工作总结大会上，部门负责人既充分肯定了团队取得的优异业绩，也实事求是地指出了当前管理流程中存在的短板与不足。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài niánzhōng gōngzuò zǒngjié dàhuì shàng, bùmén fùzérén jì chōngfèn kěndìng le tuánduì qǔdé de yōuyì yèjì, yě shíshì-qiúshì de zhǐchū le dāngqián guǎnlǐ liúchéng zhōng cúnzài de duǎnbǎn yǔ bùzú.
example_sentences.en: At the year-end review, the department head affirmed the team's achievements while pointing out shortcomings in current workflows.
example_sentences.es: En el balance de fin de año, el jefe elogió los logros del equipo al tiempo que señaló con rigor las lagunas y deficiencias en la gestión.

collocations.en: make up for shortcomings; remedy defects

idioms.meaning_en: negligible; trivial; not worth mentioning
ability falling short of one's will; powerless
pull up jacket and expose elbows; short of funds
self-knowledge; knowing one's own limitations

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of a floral calyx before opening, borrowed phonetically in classical antiquity to serve as the absolute negative adverb.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A horizontal line (一) blocking the downward strokes below signals a firm, decisive negation: 'not' (不).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una barra horizontal (一) que cierra el paso a los trazos inferiores formula una negación terminante: no (不).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictograph showing a human calf and foot 止 planted firmly on solid earth, conveying stability, completion, and fullness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Standing firmly on two strong feet (足) planted solidly on the ground represents having ample strength and sufficiency (足).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Apoyarse con firmeza sobre ambos pies (足) erguidos en el suelo denota estabilidad y suficiencia plena (足).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 初出茅庐的年轻手艺人虽然理论熟练，但面对复杂的榫卯结构，终因动手经验不足而屡屡受挫。老木匠耐心鼓励他多看多练，因为任何精湛的技艺都需要岁月打磨。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chūchū-máolú de niánqīng shǒuyìrén suīrán lǐlùn shúliàn, dàn miànduì fùzá de sǔnmǎo jiégòu, zhōng yīn dòngshǒu jīngyàn bùzú ér lǚlǚ shòucuò. Lǎo mùjiang nàixīn gǔlì tā duō kàn duō liàn, yīnwèi rènhé jīngzhàn de jìyì dōu xūyào suìyuè dǎmó.
extended_reading_passages.en: Though adept in theory, the novice artisan stumbled on complex mortise-and-tenon joints due to lacking hands-on experience. The master carpenter encouraged him, as mastery requires time.
extended_reading_passages.es: Aunque dominaba la teoría, el joven aprendiz erraba en los ensambles por falta de destreza manual. El viejo ebanista le exhortó a practicar, pues la maestría exige el cincel del tiempo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: “学然后知不足，教然后知困。”古圣先贤的教诲深刻揭示了认知递进的辩证规律。唯有清醒认识到自身的局限与不足，保持虚怀若谷的治学胸襟，才能在探索真理的道路上永不停滞。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: "Xué ránhòu zhī bùzú, jiào ránhòu zhī kùn." Gǔ shèng xiānxián de jiàohuì shēnkè jiēshì le rènzhī dìjìn de biànzhèng guīlǜ. Wéiyǒu qīngxǐng rènshí dào zìshēn de júxiàn yǔ bùzú, bǎochí xūhuái-ruògǔ de zhìxué xiōngjīn, cáinéng zài tànsuǒ zhēnlǐ de dàolù shàng yǒng bù tíngzhì.
extended_reading_passages.en: "Only after learning does one know one's deficiency; only after teaching does one know perplexity." Recognizing limitations with humility ensures progress on the path of truth.
extended_reading_passages.es: "Solo tras aprender se conoce la propia limitación; solo tras enseñar se comprende la dificultad". Reconocer las deficiencias con humildad alienta el paso hacia la verdad.

meanings_summary.en: on the contrary; contrariwise; actually; unexpectedly; inverted; pour
meanings_summary.es: al contrario; por el contrario; en cambio; en realidad; al revés; verter

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A standing person (亻) who tilts or turns arriving (到) upside-down embodies doing the reverse or turning out contrary to expectation (倒).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una persona (亻) que al llegar (到) gira en sentido inverso encarna el giro contrario o inesperado (倒).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 倒 is famous in Chinese Spring Festival culture in the pun 'Fú dào le' (福倒了 / 福到了 - Fortune is turned upside down / Fortune has arrived). Pasting the character 福 upside down on front doors playfully welcomes arriving prosperity.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone: 'dào' (51). Deliver with a crisp, dropping pitch trajectory from the upper register to the lowest.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 倒 as an adverb highlights an unexpected turning of expectations, concessions, or contrariwise situations.

contrasts.analysis: 倒 can be mildly conversational and express subtle concession (味道倒不错), whereas 反而 indicates a strong, objective contrast or opposite outcome (不但没好，反而加重了).
倒 expresses unexpected nuance or mild concession, while 却 is a direct adversative conjunction expressing a sharp turning transition (想去，却没时间).
倒 is a versatile monosyllabic adverb, whereas 倒是 emphasizes concession before a qualification (质量倒是不错，就是价格偏高).

Right side is 刂 with 禾 inside, different structure
Right side is 两 instead of 到
Right side is 俞 instead of 到

senses.definition_es: adverbio que denota contraste inesperado, concesión o resultado contrario a lo previsto
senses.example_phrase: 倒挺有意思 (actually quite interesting)

senses.definition_en: to turn upside down, reverse order, or move backward
senses.definition_es: poner algo al revés, invertir la dirección o retroceder
senses.example_phrase: 倒车 (back up a car / reverse)

senses.definition_en: to pour out liquid, tea, or contents from a container

example_sentences.hanzi: 原以为这部晦涩的历史纪录片会枯燥无味，看完之后倒觉得引人入胜、发人深省。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yuányǐwéi zhè bù huìsè de lìshǐ jìlùpiàn huì kūzào-wúwèi, kànwán zhīhòu dào juéde yǐnrén-rùshèng, fārén-shēnxǐng.
example_sentences.en: I originally thought this obscure history documentary would be dry and dull, but after watching it, I actually found it fascinating and thought-provoking.
example_sentences.es: Creí que aquel documental histórico resultaría árido y tedioso; no obstante, al terminarlo me pareció en cambio apasionante y revelador.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在复杂的商业博弈中，急功近利往往适得其反；潜下心来夯实产品质量，倒能够厚积薄发、赢得市场的长远信赖。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài fùzá de shāngyè bóyì zhōng, jígōng-jìnlì wǎngwǎng shìdéqífǎn; qiánxià xīn lái hāngshí chǎnpǐn zhìliàng, dào nénggòu hòujī-bófā, yíngdé shìchǎng de chángyuǎn xìnlài.
example_sentences.en: In complex business games, seeking quick gains often backfires; taking time to solidify quality can actually build lasting market trust.
example_sentences.es: En las disputas mercantiles, el afán de lucro rápido suele ser contraproducente; cuidar la calidad rinde en cambio frutos sólidos y credibilidad.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where person radical 亻 combines with 到 (arrive/reach), illustrating an erect human leaning over or inverting posture.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person (亻) tilting over upon arrival (到) reverses their position, signifying unexpected inversion and contrary turns (倒).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona (亻) que al llegar (到) se reclina o vuelca de improviso invierte su postura, denotando el giro contrario a lo esperado (倒).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 暴风雨来临前的午后，原本酷热难耐的闷气被阵阵穿堂风驱散，庭院里倒显出一丝难得的清凉。祖孙俩坐在竹椅上剥着莲蓬，听着屋檐下风铃叮咚作响。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bàofēngyǔ láilín qián de wǔhòu, yuánběn kùrè-nánnài de mēnqì bèi zhènzhèn chuāntángfēng qūsàn, tíngyuàn lǐ dào xiǎnchū yì sī nándé de qīngliáng. Zǔsūn liǎ zuò zài zhúyǐ shàng bō zhe liánpeng, tīngzhe wūyán xià fēnglíng dīngdōng zuòxiǎng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Before the storm, the stifling heat was dispersed by cross-breezes; the courtyard actually felt refreshingly cool. Grandparent and child shelled lotus pods beneath chiming wind bells.
extended_reading_passages.es: Antes de la tormenta, el bochorno se disipó con la brisa; el patio adquirió en cambio un frescor reconfortante. Abuelo y nieto desgranaban lotos escuchando el tintineo del carillón.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在人际交往中，刻意讨好往往使人感到虚浮造作，倒不如坦诚相待、展现最真实质朴的自我。真诚的拙朴往往比虚饰的圆滑更能跨越隔阂，赢得长久而深厚的友谊。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng, kèyì tǎohǎo wǎngwǎng shǐ rén gǎndào xūfú-zàozuò, dào bùrú tǎnchéng xiāngdài, zhǎnxiàn zuì zhēnshí zhìpǔ de zìwǒ. Zhēnchéng de zhuōpǔ wǎngwǎng bǐ xūshì de yuánhuá gèng néng kuàyuè géhé, yíngdé chángjiǔ ér shēnhòu de yǒuyì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In relationships, deliberate flattery feels contrived; it is actually better to be sincere and authentic. Genuine simplicity bridges divides better than superficial slickness.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el trato social, el halago fingido resulta artificioso; es en cambio preferible mostrarse franco y auténtico. La sencillez sincera une más que la zalamería y forja amistades duraderas.

meanings_summary.en: steamed bun; mantou; Chinese plain steamed bread (without filling)
meanings_summary.es: panecillo al vapor; mantou; pan chino tradicional al vapor sin relleno

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Steamed leavened wheat bread (馒) rounded into plump, smooth domes like little heads (头) makes comforting steamed buns (馒头).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La masa de harina al vapor (馒) moldeada en forma de pequeñas cabecitas redondas (头) compone el panecillo tradicional (馒头).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Legend attributes the invention of mantou (馒头) to Three Kingdoms strategist Zhuge Liang (诸葛亮) during his southern expedition across the Lu River (泸水). Rather than sacrificing human heads to river spirits, he shaped wheat flour loaves into head-like buns.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by neutral tone: 'mán tou' (35-neutral). Rise steadily on 'mán' and pronounce 'tou' lightly without stress.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 馒头 refers specifically to plain, solid steamed wheat buns without any internal filling.

contrasts.analysis: 馒头 is solid steamed dough with no internal filling, whereas 包子 has an inner savory (meat, veg) or sweet (bean paste) filling wrapped inside dough.
馒头 is cooked via moist high-temperature steaming (蒸), whereas 面包 is baked in dry ovens (烤), having an outer crust.
馒头 is shaped into smooth rounded or oval buns, while 花卷 is layered, twisted, and brushed with oil, scallions, or spices.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has heart radical 忄 on the left instead of food 饣
Has water radical 氵 on the left instead of food 饣
Has horizontal line at top, distinct from 头
Has two dots on top and big 大 base
Different dot placement and central vertical cross

senses.definition_en: a staple food of northern China made of leavened wheat flour dough shaped into rounded loaves and steamed, typically without sweet or savory filling
senses.definition_es: bollo de masa de harina de trigo fermentada cocido al vapor sin relleno, básico en el norte de China
senses.example_phrase: 热气腾腾的馒头 (steaming hot mantou / piping hot steamed buns)

example_sentences.hanzi: 清晨的集市上，蒸笼盖刚一揭开，一股浓郁的麦香伴着滚滚白汽扑面而来，白白胖胖的馒头格外诱人。
example_sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén de jíshì shàng, zhēnglóng gài gāng yì jiēkāi, yì gǔ nóngyù de màixiāng bàn zhe gǔngǔn báiqì pūmiàn'érlái, báibái-pàngpàng de mántou géwài yòurén.
example_sentences.en: In the morning market, as the steamer lid lifted, rich wheat aromas poured forth with billowing white steam, revealing irresistible plump white mantou.
example_sentences.es: En el mercado matinal, al levantar la tapa de la vaporera brotó un denso vaho de trigo; los panecillos blancos y esponjosos resultaban tentadores.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在我国北方传统饮食文化中，暄软劲道的老面馒头不仅是日常三餐的充饥主食，也是承载乡愁的味觉记忆。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài wǒguó běifāng chuántǒng yǐnshí wénhuà zhōng, xuānruǎn jìndao de lǎomiàn mántou bùjǐn shì rìcháng sāncān de chōngjī zhǔshí, yě shì chéngzài xiāngchóu de wèijué jìyì.
example_sentences.en: In northern Chinese cuisine, soft and chewy traditional sourdough mantou is not just a staple, but a sensory embodiment of hometown nostalgia.
example_sentences.es: En la cocina tradicional del norte de China, el panecillo al vapor de masa madre no es solo alimento diario, sino la memoria afectiva del hogar.

idioms.meaning_en: simple tea and plain rice; modest rustic diet
well-clothed and well-fed; live in plenty
when hungry, one does not choose food; hunger is best sauce
appealing to everyone's taste; widely praised

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 饅. Phono-semantic character where food radical 饣 signifies leavened grain dough, and 曼 supplies sound.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Kneaded wheat dough (饣) stretched and rolled out smoothly (曼) before being placed in high steam baskets makes fluffy steamed buns (馒).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La masa de harina (饣) estirada y moldeada con primor (曼) que esponja en la vaporera da lugar al tierno panecillo (馒).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 頭. Ancient bronze character depicted a human neck and cranial head with hair on top, now serving as head and nominal noun suffix.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A human neck supporting a round cranial head (头) with eyes and mouth, also used to round off everyday nouns like steamed buns (头).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La testa redonda y erguida sobre los hombros (头), empleada como sustantivo y como sufijo cariñoso de alimentos cotidianos (头).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 冬日清晨的北方农家，灶膛里柴火正旺，大铁锅上架着高高的竹蒸笼。当白生生、热腾腾的大馒头端上桌，掰开一块抹上芝麻酱，那一口朴实醇厚的面香直透心底。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dōngrì qīngchén de běifāng nóngjiā, zàotáng lǐ cháihuo zhèng wàng, dà tiěguō shàng jià zhe gāogāo de zhúzhēnglóng. Dāng báishēngshēng, rèténgténg de dà mántou duān shàngzhuō, bāikāi yí kuài mǒ shàng zhīmajiàng, nà yì kǒu pǔshí chúnhòu de miànxiāng zhí tòu xīndǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: On winter mornings in northern homes, firewood roars under iron cauldrons and bamboo steamers. Tearing into a hot, white mantou spread with sesame paste fills the heart with pure aroma.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el alba invernal de la aldea norteña, la leña crepita bajo la vaporera. Al abrir un tierno panecillo humeante y untarlo con sésamo, su sabor franco reconforta las entrañas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 从三国时期诸葛亮以面代首的传奇演化，到如今成为北方千家万户不可或缺的餐桌主角，看似普通的馒头见证了华夏面食文化的千年演进，蕴含着厚重质朴的生活智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Cóng Sānguó shíqī Zhūgě Liàng yǐ miàn dài shǒu de chuánqí yǎnhuà, dào rújīn chéngwéi běifāng qiānjiā-wànhù bùkě-huòquē de cānzhuō zhǔjiào, kànsì pǔtōng de mántou jiànzhèng le Huáxià miànshí wénhuà de qiānnián yǎnjìn, yùnhán zhe hòuzhòng zhìpǔ de shēnghuó zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: From Zhuge Liang's legend to northern family tables today, the humble mantou bears witness to millennia of Chinese wheat culinary culture, brimming with simple wisdom of daily life.
extended_reading_passages.es: Desde la leyenda de Zhuge Liang hasta los hogares del norte, el modesto panecillo al vapor encarna milenios de tradición culinaria harinera, albergando la sobria sabiduría del sustento popular.

meanings_summary.en: measure word for small round or granular things (pearls, teeth, seeds, stars, hearts, pills)
meanings_summary.es: clasificador para objetos menudos, esféricos o granulares (perlas, dientes, semillas, estrellas, píldoras)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A round orchard fruit (果) alongside the head radical (页) counts tiny rounded heads, pearls, and seeds (颗).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El fruto redondo (果) junto al radical de cabeza (页) mide los granos esféricos, dientes y perlas (颗).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Chinese measure words reflect profound visual-spatial categorization. 颗 is reserved for spherical, granular, or deeply treasured single units (一颗明珠, 一颗爱国心), capturing both shape and metaphorical singular integrity.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-level 1st tone: 'kē' (55). Pronounce with an elevated, level pitch sustained evenly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 颗 is the measure word specifically designating small, roundish, spherical, or granular objects.

contrasts.analysis: 颗 (page 页) is for small round objects (一颗红豆, 一颗牙齿), whereas 棵 (tree 木) is exclusively for trees and botanical plants (一棵大树, 一棵青菜).
颗 is slightly larger or can count abstract things (一颗心, 一颗行星), while 粒 is strictly for tiny grains and pellets (一粒沙子, 一粒米).
颗 vividly captures the round, discrete, crystalline nature of the noun, while 个 is the generic, neutral classifier.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has tree radical 木 on the left instead of 页 on right

look_alikes.meaning_en: classifier for plants vs round things
look_alikes.distinction_note: 棵 is for trees (一棵树); 颗 is for grains/stars (一颗星)
Has cave radical 穴 on top of 果
Contains 果 on left and 页 on right
Has 卢 on left of 页

senses.definition_en: classifier used to count small, roundish, granular, or spherical objects such as pearls, beads, seeds, teeth, stars, raindrops, or hearts
senses.definition_es: clasificador nominal para contar objetos redondos, granos, perlas, dientes, estrellas o el corazón
senses.example_phrase: 一颗珍珠 (a pearl / one pearl)

example_sentences.hanzi: 仰望晴朗深邃的夏夜星空，无数颗繁星宛如碎钻般镶嵌在黑天鹅绒幕布上，闪烁着清冷神秘的光芒。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yǎngwàng qínglǎng shēnsuì de xiàyè xīngkōng, wúshù kē fánxīng wǎnrú suìzuàn bān xiāngqiàn zài hēi tiān'éróng mùbù shàng, shǎnshuò zhe qīnglěng shénmì de guāngmáng.
example_sentences.en: Gazing up into the clear summer night sky, countless stars like diamond chips embedded in black velvet flickered with cool, mysterious light.
example_sentences.es: Al alzar la vista al firmamento estival, miríadas de estrellas titilaban como esquirlas de diamante sobre terciopelo negro con misterioso fulgor.

example_sentences.hanzi: 每一颗破土而出的幼苗，都必须经历风雨的洗礼与烈日的炙烤，方能扎深根系、茁壮成长为参天大树。
example_sentences.pinyin: Měi yì kē pòtǔ'érchū de yòumiáo, dōu bìxū jīnglì fēngyǔ de xǐlǐ yǔ lièrì de zhìkǎo, fāng néng zhāshēn gēnxì, zhuózhuàng chéngzhǎng wéi cāntiān dàshù.
example_sentences.en: Every tiny seedling breaking through the soil must undergo trials of wind and scorching sun before striking deep roots to grow into a towering tree.
example_sentences.es: Cada tierna plántula que brota de la tierra debe soportar el azote de las lluvias y el ardor solar antes de echar raíces hondas y erguirse imponente.

idioms.meaning_en: millions of people united as one heart; concerted effort
pure innocent heart of a newborn; utter sincerity
a single grain of millet in the vast ocean; drop in the bucket
every single grain represents bitter toil

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 顆. Phono-semantic compound combining round fruit 果 with head radical 页, originally denoting small rounded lumps or pearls.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Round fruit (果) shaped like a small head (页) provides the standard measure word for individual grains, pearls, and stars (颗).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Frutos esféricos (果) con la redondez de una cabeza (页) dan origen al contador de cuentas, perlas y semillas (颗).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 掌心里静静躺着三颗饱满的橡子，光滑的褐色外壳在晨光下泛着油润的光泽。老人微微一笑，将这几颗微不足道的小坚果分给围拢上来的猴群，化解了一场剑拔弩张的争吵。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhǎngxīn lǐ jìngjìng tǎng zhe sān kē bǎomǎn de xiàngzi, guānghua de hèsè wàiké zài chénguāng xià fàn zhe yóurùn de guāngzé. Lǎorén wēiwēi yíxiào, jiāng zhè jǐ kē wēibùzúdào de xiǎojiānguǒ fēngěi wéilǒng shànglái de hóuqún, huàjiě le yì chǎng jiànbá-nǔzhāng de zhēngchǎo.
extended_reading_passages.en: In his palm lay three plump acorns, their smooth brown shells gleaming in morning light. The old man smiled, handing the tiny nuts to the monkeys to defuse their agitation.
extended_reading_passages.es: En su palma descansaban tres relucientes bellotas de suave cáscara castaña. El anciano sonrió y repartió aquellos frutos entre los monos apaciguando su conato de rebelión.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 科学探索的宏大殿堂，往往正是由科学家对一颗微小细胞或一颗遥远彗星的执着追问所奠基的。正是这种穷极造化、见微知著的探究精神，指引着人类文明不断冲破未知的迷雾。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Kēxué tànsuǒ de hóngdà diàntáng, wǎngwǎng zhèngshì yóu kēxuéjiā duì yì kē wēixiǎo xìbāo huò yì kē yáoyuǎn huìxīng de zhízhuó zhuīwèn suǒ diànjī de. Zhèngshì zhèzhǒng qióngjí-zàohuà, jiànwēi-zhīzhù de tànjiū jīngshén, zhǐyǐn zhe rénlèi wénmíng bùduàn chōngpò wèizhī de míwù.
extended_reading_passages.en: The grand hall of scientific discovery is founded upon questioning a tiny cell or a distant comet. This pursuit of uncovering nature's subtleties guides humanity through unknown mists.
extended_reading_passages.es: El templo de la ciencia se asienta en la indagación paciente de una diminuta célula o un lejano cometa. Ese afán por desentrañar los secretos del cosmos guía a la humanidad en la penumbra.

meanings_summary.en: as if; it seems; seemingly; apparently; looking like
meanings_summary.es: al parecer; parece que; como si; aparentemente; semejante a

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Resembling someone's image (似) coupled with a questioning sigh of wonder (乎) creates the tentative impression that it seems or appears so (似乎).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Parecerse a la imagen de algo (似) sumado a un suspiro interrogativo (乎) sugiere que así parece ser (似乎).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Chinese literary and epistemological rhetoric emphasizes epistemic humility (慎言 / 存疑). Adverbs like 似乎 soften assertions into prudent approximations, avoiding dogmatic certainty in matters of subtle perception.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by high-level 1st tone: 'sì hū' (51-55). Plunge crisply on 'sì' before springing up to sustained high pitch on 'hū'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 似乎 is an adverb indicating subjective, intuitive conjecture or a cautious impression of probability.

contrasts.analysis: 似乎 is more formal and literary, whereas 好像 is universal in casual spoken dialogue.
似乎 expresses logical probability or tentative judgment, while 仿佛 carries poetic or illusory overtones of dreamlike resemblance.
似乎 describes how a situation currently looks or strikes the senses, whereas 也许 expresses a factual, statistical possibility ("maybe / perhaps").

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the person radical 亻 on the left
Has hand radical 扌 on the left instead of person 亻
Top stroke is horizontal, lacking 乎's curved hook
Top strokes differ and has vertical cutting straight down
Has mouth radical 口 on the left of 乎

senses.definition_en: expressing uncertain conjecture, tentative inference, or cautious impression ("seemingly", "as though", "it appears")
senses.definition_es: adverbio que expresa conjetura prudente, impresión dubitativa o apariencia ("parece que", "al parecer")
senses.example_phrase: 似乎明白 (seemingly understand / appear to grasp)

example_sentences.hanzi: 窗外飘起了淅淅沥沥的细雨，路上的行人都加快了脚步，天色似乎比往常暗得更早了一些。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài piāoqǐ le xīxī-lìlì de xìyǔ, lùshang de xíngrén dōu jiākuài le jiǎobù, tiānsè sìhū bǐ wǎngcháng àn de gèng zǎo le yìxiē.
example_sentences.en: Outside the window, a drizzle began to fall; pedestrians quickened their pace, and dusk seemed to descend earlier than usual.
example_sentences.es: Por la ventana caía una mansa llovizna; los transeúntes apuraban el paso y el anochecer parecía adelantarse más de lo habitual.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对浩瀚复杂的未知宇宙，人类已有的科学认知似乎仅仅触及了冰山一角，更多的自然奥秘依然深藏在黑暗之中。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì hàohàn fùzá de wèizhī yǔzhòu, rénlèi yǐyǒu de kēxué rènzhī sìhū jǐnjǐn chùjí le bīngshān-yìjiǎo, gèngduō de zìrán àomì yīrán shēncáng zài hēi'àn zhīzhōng.
example_sentences.en: Confronting the vast cosmos, existing human scientific knowledge seems merely to touch the tip of an iceberg, with vast mysteries still hidden in darkness.
example_sentences.es: Ante la inmensidad del cosmos, el saber científico humano parece apenas rozar la punta del iceberg, permaneciendo ocultos infinitos arcanos.

collocations.en: seems to make sense; apparently plausible
it looks like rain; seemingly about to rain
seemingly tinged with regret; apparently somewhat regretful

idioms.meaning_en: seem to understand yet not understand; half-comprehending
seemingly right but actually wrong; specious
as if separated by an entire epoch; dreamlike passing of time
look at without seeing; turn a blind eye to

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character combining person radical 亻 with phonetic 以, signifying taking after someone or resembling closely.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: One person (亻) standing alongside another (以) looks strikingly alike, evoking resemblance and tentative likeness (似).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona (亻) junto a otra (以) muestra un parecido asombroso, transmitiendo semejanza y apariencia probable (似).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of a person's breath and voice 丂 dispersing into the air with an exclamatory sigh, denoting wonder or doubt.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An exhale of breath lingering in air with questioning doubt, lending an air of conjecture and wonder to statements (乎).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un suspiro que se exhala en el aire con suave duda, aportando un matiz de conjetura y reflexión (乎).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 走在暮色笼罩的古镇石板路上，远处隐隐约约传来江南评弹的琵琶声。那幽婉低回的旋律，似乎正从百年前的幽深弄堂穿越时空而来，让人恍惚置身于如烟往昔。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǒu zài mùsè lǒngzhào de gǔzhèn shíbǎnlù shàng, yuǎnchù yǐnyǐn-yuēyuē chuánlái Jiāngnán píngtán de pípa shēng. Nà yōuwǎn dīhuí de xuánlǜ, sìhū zhèng cóng bǎinián qián de yōushēn lòngtáng chuānyuè shíkōng ér lái, ràng rén huǎnghū zhìshēn yú rúyān wǎngxī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Walking ancient flagstones at dusk, faint pipa notes of Jiangnan pingtan drifted from afar. The melodious strains seemed to travel across a century of deep alleys, evoking bygone eras.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al caminar por los adoquines del pueblo al atardecer, llegaban notas de laúd pingtan desde la lejanía. Aquella melodía parecía viajar a través de los siglos sumiéndonos en un ensueño.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代人身处快节奏的数字洪流之中，整日忙于刷取信息，内心的专注与沉静似乎正在不知不觉中被悄然蚕食。偶尔合上屏幕回归书卷，才能重新找回灵魂深处的安宁与从容。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndàirén shēnchǔ kuàijièzòu de shùzì hóngliú zhīzhōng, zhěngrì mángyú shuāqǔ xìnxī, nèixīn de zhuānzhù yǔ chénjìng sìhū zhèngzài bùzhī-bùjué zhōng bèi qiǎorán cánshí. Ǒu'ěr héshàng píngmù huíguī shūjuàn, cáinéng chóngxīn zhǎohuí línghún shēnchù de ānníng yǔ cóngróng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Caught in the rapid digital torrent, modern minds are busy browsing; inner focus and calm seem quietly eroded. Closing screens to return to books restores peace and composure to the soul.
extended_reading_passages.es: Inmersos en la vorágine digital, los hombres de hoy devoran pantallas mientras su calma interior parece erosionarse sin tregua. Cerrar los monitores rescata el sosiego del alma.

meanings_summary.en: to suffer losses; to get the short end of the stick; to be at a disadvantage; disadvantageous
meanings_summary.es: salir perdiendo; sufrir pérdidas; salir perjudicado; llevar las de perder; estar en desventaja

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Swallowing with one's mouth (吃) the bitter shortfall and deficit of a raw deal (亏) captures suffering losses and losing out (吃亏).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Tragar por la boca (吃) la merma y el desfalco amargo (亏) define sufrir pérdidas y salir perjudicado (吃亏).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The cultural motto 'Chīkuī shì fú' (吃亏是福) was made famous by Qing dynasty painter Zheng Banqiao (郑板桥). In Chinese social psychology, voluntarily accepting minor disadvantages builds moral capital, prevents envious enmity, and harmonizes community relations.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Double high-level 1st tones: 'chī kuī' (55-55). Maintain a crisp, elevated pitch trajectory across both syllables evenly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 吃亏 emphasizes ending up in an unfair, disadvantageous, or losing position in dealings with others.

contrasts.analysis: 吃亏 denotes losing out or receiving unfair terms in an interaction, while 失败 means failing to achieve a goal or being defeated in a contest.
吃亏 implies being taken advantage of or suffering a concrete loss (often avoidable through wisdom), while 倒霉 emphasizes blind bad luck or arbitrary misfortune.
吃亏 suggests an involuntary or unreciprocated loss, whereas 牺牲 denotes noble, conscious self-sacrifice for a greater cause.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Right side is 丩 instead of 乞
Right side is 及 instead of 乞
Lacks the mouth radical 口 on the left
Second horizontal stroke is longer, lacks hook bottom
Has point dot on top right

senses.definition_en: to suffer economic losses, damage, or unfair disadvantages in a transaction or rivalry
senses.definition_es: sufrir quebrantos materiales, desventajas o perjuicios en tratos o contiendas
senses.example_phrase: 吃亏上当 (suffer losses and get cheated)

senses.definition_en: to be in an unfavorable position or suffer setbacks due to a specific personal shortcoming or vulnerability
senses.definition_es: estar en clara desventaja debido a cierta limitación o flaqueza personal
senses.example_phrase: 吃了没经验的亏 (suffered for lack of experience)

example_sentences.hanzi: 购买二手汽车时一定要请专业检修师傅帮忙把关，切莫贪图便宜盲目付款，以免日后吃大亏。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi èrshǒu qìchē shí yídìng yào qǐng zhuānyè jiǎnxiū shīfu bāngmáng bǎguān, qièmò tāntú piányi mángmù fùkuǎn, yǐmiǎn rìhòu chī dàkuī.
example_sentences.en: When buying a used car, always ask a professional mechanic to inspect it; never rush to pay for petty bargains, or you will suffer big losses later.
example_sentences.es: Al comprar un coche usado es indispensable que lo revise un perito; no se apresure por ahorrar cuatro cuartos si no quiere salir malparado luego.

example_sentences.hanzi: 中国民间常讲“吃亏是福”，这并非消极忍让，而是提倡一种宽厚待人、不锱铢必较的豁达处世智慧。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó mínjiān cháng jiǎng "chīkuī shì fú", zhè bìngfēi xiāojí rěnràng, érshì tíchàng yì zhǒng kuānhòu dàirén, bù zīzhū-bìjiào de huòdá chǔshì zhìhuì.
example_sentences.en: The Chinese saying "taking a loss is a blessing" is not passive submission, but an open-minded wisdom urging generosity rather than pettiness over trifles.
example_sentences.es: El adagio chino "ceder en pérdidas es ventura" no predica sumisión, sino la generosa sabiduría de no regatear pequeñeces y convivir con magnanimidad.

collocations.en: never accept disadvantage; refuse to lose out
suffer a severe setback; take a huge hit
suffer minor loss to gain major advantage
taking a loss is a blessing; magnanimity brings good fortune

idioms.meaning_en: taking a loss brings blessings; tolerance yields good fortune
lose big over small gains; penny wise and pound foolish
attend to one while losing another; unable to balance both
the gains do not offset the losses; not worth the candle

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where mouth radical 口 depicts consuming food or absorbing impact, and 乞 supplies sound.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An open mouth (口) taking in and swallowing bitter portions, metaphorically enduring hardship or financial loss (吃).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una boca abierta (口) que traga amarguras sin rechistar, simbolizando encajar pérdidas o quebrantos (吃).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 虧. Ancient oracle pictograph of a sighing breath 丂 encountering a gap or deficit in offerings, signifying loss and deficiency.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: When expected gains fail to match reality, a heavy sigh escapes over the hollow shortfall and deficit (亏).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ante la falta de beneficios justos, se escapa un hondo suspiro por la mengua y el desfalco sufrido (亏).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 初入职场的年轻人总害怕多干活吃亏，殊不知那些主动承担杂事、不计较一时得失的人，反而在悄然中积累了最扎实的实战经验与良好的人缘口碑。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chūrù zhíchǎng de niánqīngrén zǒng hàipà duō gànhuó chīkuī, shūbùzhī nàxiē zhǔdòng chéngdān záshì, bú jìjiào yìshí déshī de rén, fǎn'ér zài qiǎorán zhōng jīlěi le zuì zhāshi de shízhàn jīngyàn yǔ liánghǎo de rényuán kǒubēi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Novices entering the workplace often fear taking on extra work and losing out, unaware that shouldering tasks builds valuable practical experience and trust.
extended_reading_passages.es: Quienes debutan en el trabajo temen salir perdiendo al asumir más tareas, sin reparar en que esa solícita entrega les forja una experiencia sólida y buen aprecio.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 庄子寓言中的猴群见“朝三暮四”便怒目圆睁，误以为自己吃了大亏；及至改为“朝四暮三”，便个个喜笑颜开。这则幽默的故事深刻警示我们，切莫被眼前的得失算计蒙蔽了审视全局的智慧眼光。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhuāngzǐ yùyán zhōng de hóuqún jiàn "zhāosān-mùsì" biàn nùmù-yuánzhēng, wùyǐwéi zìjǐ chī le dàkuī; jízhì gǎi wéi "zhāosì-mùsān", biàn gègè xǐxiào-yánkāi. Zhè zé yōumò de gùshì shēnkè jǐngshì wǒmen, qièmò bèi yǎnqián de déshī suànjì méngbì le shěnshì quánjú de zhìhuì yǎnguāng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In Zhuangzi's fable, the monkeys were enraged at "three in morning and four at night", fearing a raw deal, yet rejoiced when reversed. This warns us not to let petty accounting blind our holistic perspective.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la fábula del Zhuangzi, los monos chillaban creyendo salir perjudicados con tres bellotas al alba; al trocarlas a cuatro, bailaron alegres. La historia nos alerta contra la cerrazón miope ante los balances globales.

meanings_summary.en: way; pattern; style; manner; mode; method
meanings_summary.es: manera; modo; forma; método; estilo; modalidad

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The directional method (方) measured against standard carpenter's models (式) defines a systematic way, manner, or pattern (方式).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El método y rumbo certero (方) ajustado a la escuadra y modelo reglamentario (式) define la manera o estilo de proceder (方式).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese administrative and technical treatises, 'fāng' (方) denoted practical recipes and navigational routes, while 'shì' (式) signified institutional rites and cosmic models. Combined into 方式, it frames how human actions conform to patterned paths.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-level 1st tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'fāng shì' (55-51). Hold 'fāng' sustained and level, then snap downward decisively on 'shì'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 方式 refers to the observable style, mode, pattern, or manner in which an activity is carried out.

contrasts.analysis: 方式 denotes a broader style, habit, or mode (生活方式, 沟通方式), while 方法 refers to concrete procedural steps and technical tools used to solve a specific problem (教学方法, 试验方法).
方式 is the behavioral pattern or manner of action, whereas 形式 is the external visible appearance or formal structure (形式主义).
方式 is flexible and conversational, while 模式 implies an institutionalized, repeatable, and codified theoretical model (商业模式).

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the top dot and horizontal overhang of 方
Lacks the dot and horizontal line of 方
Has speech radical 讠 on the left before 式
Has hand radical 扌 on the left before 式
Left side has 止, different bottom structure

senses.definition_en: a specific manner, method, pattern, or mode in which something is done, experienced, or expressed
senses.definition_es: forma, procedimiento, pauta o estilo particular según el cual se realiza, expresa o experimenta algo
senses.example_phrase: 生活方式 (way of life / lifestyle)

example_sentences.hanzi: 随着互联网技术的普及，越来越多年轻人选择以远程办公的方式平衡工作与家庭生活。
example_sentences.pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng jìshù de pǔjí, yuèláiyuè duō niánqīngrén xuǎnzé yǐ yuǎnchéng bàngōng de fāngshì pínghéng gōngzuò yǔ jiātíng shēnghuó.
example_sentences.en: With the spread of internet technology, an increasing number of young people choose remote work to balance career and home.
example_sentences.es: Con la difusión de Internet, cada vez más jóvenes eligen el teletrabajo como modo de equilibrar sus obligaciones laborales y familiares.

example_sentences.hanzi: 解决复杂争端的最佳方式绝非单方面的强权施压，而是秉持相互尊重与求同存异的原则开展建设性对话。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jiějué fùzá zhēngduān de zuìjiā fāngshì juéfēi dānfāngmiàn de qiángquán shīyā, érshì bǐngchí xiānghù zūnzhòng yǔ qiútóng-cúnyì de yuánzé kāizhǎn jiànshèxìng duìhuà.
example_sentences.en: The optimal way to resolve complex disputes is by no means unilateral coercion, but engaging in constructive dialogue based on mutual respect.
example_sentences.es: La vía óptima para dirimir disputas arduas jamás será la imposición unilateral, sino el diálogo constructivo fundado en el respeto recíproco.

collocations.en: mode of expression; form of rhetoric

idioms.meaning_en: hoist a distinct banner of one's own; unique style
a thousand pieces following the same tune; stereotyped
tailor measures to suit local conditions
drift with the waves; go with the flow blindly

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of two plows lashed together or an ancient directional compass square, signifying orientation, square precision, and prescribed path.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A directional square marker (方) pointing toward cardinal routes gives the direction and precise method for navigating tasks (方).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una brújula cuadrada (方) orientada hacia los cuatro rumbos marca el rumbo exacto y el método certero de acción (方).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient character combining carpenter's square 工 with marker stake 弋, denoting standard templates, models, and formal ceremonies.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A carpenter's square (工) pegged against a stake (弋) sets the standard model and ceremonial pattern for all crafts (式).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La escuadra del artesano (工) fijada a la estaca de replanteo (弋) establece la pauta reglamentaria y el estilo maestro (式).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着倡导绿色环保理念的深入人心，选择公共交通或骑自行车出行的健康生活方式，逐渐成为城市年轻人的时尚新潮流。不仅强健了体魄，更让城市的空气愈发清新宜人。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe chàngdǎo lǜsè huánbǎo lǐniàn de shēnrù-rénxīn, xuǎnzé gōnggòng jiāotōng huò qí zìxíngchē chūxíng de jiànkāng shēnghuó fāngshì, zhújiàn chéngwéi chéngshì niánqīngrén de shíshàng xīn cháoliú. Bùjǐn qiángjiàn le tǐpò, gèng ràng chéngshì de kōngqì yùfā qīngxīn yírén.
extended_reading_passages.en: As eco-friendly concepts take root, choosing cycling or public transit as a lifestyle has become fashionable for urban youth, boosting health and clearing city air.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con la difusión de la conciencia ecológica, el uso de la bicicleta y el transporte colectivo se consolida como estilo de vida saludable que purifica el aire de las urbes.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在多元文明交流互鉴的历史长河中，不同民族在漫长的繁衍生息中所形成的文化表达方式与生活哲学，共同构成了人类文明百花齐放的绚丽图景。彼此包容方能交相辉映。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài duōyuán wénmíng jiāoliú-hùjiàn de lìshǐ chánghé zhōng, bùtóng mínzú zài màncháng de fányǎn-shēngxī zhōng suǒ xíngchéng de wénhuà biǎodá fāngshì yǔ shēnghuó zhéxué, gòngtóng gòuchéng le rénlèi wénmíng bǎihuā-qífàng de xuànlì tújǐng. Bǐcǐ bāoróng fāng néng jiāoxiāng-huìyìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In civilizational exchanges, the modes of cultural expression and philosophies cultivated by diverse peoples form humanity's tapestry. Mutual tolerance allows cultures to shine together.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el fluir de la historia, las variadas formas de expresión y filosofías forjadas por los pueblos componen el tapiz de la humanidad. La tolerancia recíproca enaltece ese acervo.

meanings_summary.en: to comfort; to console; to soothe; consolation; comfort; solace
meanings_summary.es: consolar; confortar; aliviar; consuelo; solaz; alivio

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Sheltering someone safely under a roof (安) while gently soothing their sorrowful heart (慰) offers loving comfort and consolation (安慰).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dar cobijo tranquilo bajo techo (安) acariciando el corazón adolorido (慰) brinda consuelo y bálsamo reparador (安慰).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Confucian interpersonal ethics (仁爱 / 恻隐之心), empathy toward another's grief is the very wellspring of humanity. Verbal comfort (慰藉) serves not merely as polite pleasantry, but as an active moral duty to restore emotional harmony.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-level 1st tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'ān wèi' (55-51). Hold 'ān' high and tranquil, then drop resolutely with warm emphasis on 'wèi'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 安慰 focuses on alleviating psychological pain, distress, or grief through compassionate speech and presence.

contrasts.analysis: 安慰 is offered to someone who is hurting or in distress (安慰伤心的人), whereas 欣慰 is self-experienced joy and relief at a positive outcome (感到十分欣慰).
安慰 aims to alleviate sorrow and ease emotional distress, while 鼓励 aims to boost courage, drive, and proactive action.
安慰 is a specific response to sadness or loss, while 关怀 is general ongoing care and solicitude for another's welfare.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has hand radical 扌 on the left of 安
Has wood radical 木 at the bottom of 安
Lacks the heart radical 心 at the bottom
Has grass radical 艹 on top of 尉
Has fire radical 火 at bottom instead of 心

senses.definition_en: to soothe grief, distress, disappointment, or anxiety with gentle words or empathetic actions
senses.definition_es: aliviar el dolor, la pesadumbre o el desánimo ajeno con palabras amables o gestos de empatía
senses.example_phrase: 安慰朋友 (comfort a friend / console a friend)

senses.definition_en: a person, thing, or circumstance that brings peace of mind, relief, or consolation
senses.definition_es: aquello que proporciona alivio, sosiego, serenidad o resignación moral
senses.example_phrase: 莫大的安慰 (immense consolation / great comfort)

example_sentences.hanzi: 看到好友因考试失利而伤心落泪，小林轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀，用温柔真诚的话语耐心安慰她。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kàndào hǎoyǒu yīn kǎoshì shīlì ér shāngxīn luòlèi, Xiǎolín qīngqīng pāi le pai tā de jiānbǎng, yòng wēnróu zhēnchéng de huàyǔ nàixīn ānwèi tā.
example_sentences.en: Seeing her friend weeping in grief over failing the exam, Xiaolin gently patted her shoulder and patiently consoled her with tender, sincere words.
example_sentences.es: Al ver a su amiga llorando desconsolada por suspender el examen, Xiaolin le palmeó el hombro con afecto y la consoló con palabras tiernas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 尽管老先生晚年生活清贫如洗，但得知自己毕生倾注心血的学术遗著顺利出版，内心感到了莫大的欣慰与安宁。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn lǎo xiānsheng wǎnnián shēnghuó qīngpín-rúxǐ, dàn dézhī zìjǐ bìshēng qīngzhù xīnxuè de xuéshù yízhù shùnlì chūbǎn, nèixīn gǎndào le mòdà de xīnwèi yǔ ānníng.
example_sentences.en: Though the old scholar lived in humble poverty in old age, learning that his lifetime manuscript was smoothly published brought immense solace.
example_sentences.es: Pese a vivir en modesta estrechez en su vejez, saber que su obra magna vería la luz brindó al anciano erudito un consuelo y una paz inmensos.

idioms.meaning_en: inquire solicitously about well-being; show caring concern
lay bare one's heart; treat with utmost sincerity
share weal and woe; stand together through thick and thin
moisten each other with spit; mutual aid in dire straits

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram of a woman 女 resting safely inside her sheltered domestic home 宀, conveying safety and deep serenity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A woman (女) sitting safely under the protective roof (宀) of her home embodies profound peace, safety, and tranquil calm (安).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mujer (女) descansando a salvo bajo el techo familiar (宀) irradia sosiego, seguridad y apacible serenidad (安).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where heart radical 心 denotes emotional solace, and 尉 depicts soothing hands smoothing distress.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Gentle hands (尉) touching an aching heart (心) to smooth away sorrow and worry bring soothing consolation (慰).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Manos solícitas (尉) que acarician un corazón afligido (心) mitigando las congojas brindan consuelo y alivio (慰).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对病榻前愁眉不展的母亲，儿子握紧母亲粗糙的双手，一句句轻声细语的安慰犹如春风化雨，抚平了老人心头的焦虑与惊恐，让简陋的病房也变得格外温暖。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì bìngtà qián chóuméi-bùzhǎn de mǔqīn, érzi wòjǐn mǔqīn cūcāo de shuāngshǒu, yíjùjù qīngshēng-xìyǔ de ānwèi yóurú chūnfēng-huàyǔ, fǔpíng le lǎorén xīntóu de jiāolǜ yǔ jīngkǒng, ràng jiǎnlòu de bìngfáng yě biàn de géwài wēnnuǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Before his ailing mother, the son clasped her rough hands; gentle words of comfort like spring rain smoothed her anxiety, warming the room.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante su madre enferma y compungida, el hijo estrechó sus manos callosas; sus dulces palabras de consuelo calmaron el desasosiego infundiendo calor a la estancia.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在人生跌宕起伏的逆境征程中，来自亲友的一句真诚安慰，往往能够成为身处暗夜者重燃希望的微光。它传递的不仅是言语上的抚慰，更是人类灵魂深处守望相助的力量。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài rénshēng diēdàng-qǐfú de nìjìng zhēngchéng zhōng, láizì qīnyǒu de yí jù zhēnchéng ānwèi, wǎngwǎng nénggòu chéngwéi shēnchǔ ànyè zhě chóngrán xīwàng de wēiguāng. Tā chuándì de bùjǐn shì yányǔ shàng de fǔwèi, gèng shì rénlèi línghún shēnchù shǒuwàng-xiāngzhù de lìliàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid life's bitter trials, a sincere word of comfort from kin or friend rekindles hope like a distant light, conveying soul-deep solidarity.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los trances adversos de la existencia, un consuelo leal de amigos o parientes alumbra la noche íntima, transmitiendo el fraternal auxilio del alma.

meanings_summary.en: otherwise; or else; how about; what if; alternatively
meanings_summary.es: si no; de lo contrario; qué tal si; qué te parece si; o bien

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Pivoting to what one wants (要) against what one does not (不) proposes alternative choices: 'otherwise' or 'how about' (要不).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Sopesar lo que se quiere (要) frente a lo que no (不) plantea un dilema o una sugerencia amable: 'si no' o 'qué tal si' (要不).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In colloquial spoken Mandarin, 要不 exemplifies conversational politeness and consensual negotiation (委婉商量语气). Rather than bluntly vetoing a plan, Chinese speakers propose an alternative with 要不, preserving relational harmony and face (面子).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by neutral/light tone: 'yào bu' (51-neutral). Utter 'yào' with downward inflection and keep 'bu' light and buoyant.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 要不 serves as an everyday oral connective offering an alternative proposal or stating consequences of inaction.

contrasts.analysis: 要不 is more succinct and versatile in colloquial speech, while 要不然 is slightly longer and specifically highlights conditional adverse consequences ("or else").
要不 is informal and friendly (often used to float suggestions: 要不我们去吃火锅？), while 否则 is formal and strictly signals a logical adverse result (必须准时，否则取消资格).
要不 presents an entire alternative clause or action proposal, whereas 或者 simply coordinates alternative nouns or verb phrases within a sentence.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Top is 而 instead of 覀
Bottom is 示 instead of 女
Bottom is 木 instead of 女
Has 一 at bottom under 不
Top is 不 and bottom is 正

senses.definition_en: introducing an alternative proposal or polite suggestion ("how about", "what if", "why don't we")
senses.definition_es: conjunción que formula una propuesta alternativa o sugerencia atenta ("¿qué tal si...?", "¿por qué no...?")
senses.example_phrase: 要不咱们明天去 (how about we go tomorrow / what if we go tomorrow)

senses.definition_en: indicating an adverse consequence if a condition is not met ("otherwise", "or else")
senses.definition_es: conjunción condicional adversativa que señala la consecuencia si no se cumple lo anterior ("si no", "de lo contrario")
senses.example_phrase: 赶紧走，要不就晚了 (hurry up, otherwise we'll be late)

example_sentences.hanzi: 天空阴沉沉的眼看就要下大雨了，要不我们改天再去郊外公园野餐吧。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng yīnchénchén de yǎnkàn jiù yào xià dàyǔ le, yàobu wǒmen gǎitiān zài qù jiāowài gōngyuán yěcān ba.
example_sentences.en: The sky is gloomy and heavy rain looks imminent; how about we reschedule our suburban picnic for another day?
example_sentences.es: El cielo está plomizo a punto de llover a cántaros; ¿qué tal si aplazamos el pícnic en el parque para otro día?

example_sentences.hanzi: 遇到重大决策必须事先充分调研并广泛听取各方意见，要不盲目行动极有可能导致不可挽回的巨大损失。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yùdào zhòngdà juécè bìxū shìxiān chōngfèn diàoyán bìng guǎngfàn tīngqǔ gèfāng yìjiàn, yàobu mángmù xíngdòng jí yǒukěnéng dǎozhì bùkě-wǎnhuí de jùdà sǔnshī.
example_sentences.en: When facing major decisions one must investigate thoroughly and consult widely; otherwise, reckless action may incur irreversible losses.
example_sentences.es: Al tomar decisiones cruciales hay que investigar y recabar opiniones; de lo contrario, obrar a ciegas causará perjuicios irreparables.

collocations.en: why not talk another day; how about another time
or else it will be too late
how about doing it this way
why don't you give it a try

idioms.meaning_en: take a step back and think; reconsider calmly
satisfy both sides; achieve a win-win outcome
mend roofs before rains; plan ahead for emergencies
nip trouble in the bud; prevent disaster before it occurs

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of a slender woman 女 with two hands 覀 resting upon her waist (腰), metaphorically extended to the pivotal core or requirement.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two hands grasping a slender waist (女) highlight the crucial pivotal center where decisions and wishes must be made (要).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos posadas sobre la cintura de una mujer (女) señalan el eje central sobre el que pivotan los deseos y las decisiones (要).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of a floral calyx before blooming, borrowed phonetically in classical antiquity as the primary negative particle.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A horizontal boundary stroke (一) denying passage across the strokes below produces the absolute negative (不).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una línea horizontal superior (一) que veta el paso a los trazos inferiores emite una rotunda negación (不).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 两人在山道岔路口徘徊了许久，天边的晚霞渐渐退去。看着陡峭崎岖的未知小径，向导擦了把汗提议道：“天黑下山太危险，要不咱们先在护林人的木屋歇一宿吧。”
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Liǎng rén zài shāndào chàlùkǒu páihuái le xǔjiǔ, tiānbiān de wǎnxiá jiànjiàn tuìqù. Kànzhe dǒuqiào qíqū de wèizhī xiǎojìng, xiàngdǎo cā le bǎ hàn tíyì dào: "Tiān hēi xiàshān tài wēixiǎn, yàobu zánmen xiān zài hùlínrén de mùwū xiē yì xiǔ ba."
extended_reading_passages.en: Lingering at the mountain trail fork as sunset faded, looking at steep paths, the guide wiped his brow: "Going down in the dark is perilous; how about we sleep at the cabin?"
extended_reading_passages.es: Titubeando en la bifurcación al declinar el crepúsculo sobre la abrupta vereda, el guía se enjugó el sudor: "Bajar a oscuras entraña peligro; ¿qué tal si pernoctamos en la cabaña?".

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 团队协作过程中难免出现意见分歧，倘若各自固执己见，合作势必陷入僵局。与其无休止地争吵，要不双方各退一步寻找折中方案，这才是富有建设性的沟通之道。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tuánduì xiézuò guòchéng zhōng nánmiǎn chūxiàn yìjiàn fēnqí, tǎngruò gèzì gùzhí-jǐjiàn, hézuò shìbì xiànrù jiāngjú. Yǔqí wúxiūzhǐ de zhēngchǎo, yàobu shuāngfāng gè tuì yí bù xúnzhǎo zhézhōng fāng'àn, zhè cáishì fùyǒu jiànshèxìng de gōutōng zhī dào.
extended_reading_passages.en: In team collaboration, divergent opinions are inevitable; stubbornness deadlocks cooperation. Rather than endless quarrel, why not both take a step back for a compromise?
extended_reading_passages.es: En el trabajo de equipo surgen discrepancias; la terquedad aboca al estancamiento. En vez de reñir sin fin, ¿por qué no ceder un paso en busca de un término medio constructivo?.

meanings_summary.en: to appear; to look; to seem; to manifest as; to show oneself to be
meanings_summary.es: parecer; verse; mostrarse; denotar; dar la impresión de; lucir

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Illuminated brightly like the sun (显) so that observers readily perceive (得) its presence makes an object appear or look a certain way (显得).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Iluminado con claridad solar (显) de suerte que cualquiera capte (得) su cualidad hace que algo luzca o aparente ser (显得).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese aesthetic discourse, 'xiǎn' (显 - the revealed / explicit) stands in fruitful dialectical balance with 'cáng' (藏 - the concealed / subtle). In poetry and garden design, striking things are made to 'appear' (显得) through thoughtful contrast and framing.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by neutral tone: 'xiǎn de' (214-neutral). Dip deep on 'xiǎn' and release into an unstressed, buoyant 'de'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 显得 describes how a particular attribute, emotion, or impression is visibly brought out and showcased to observers.

contrasts.analysis: 显得 often follows an adjective or describes an overall aura brought out by circumstances (显得很有活力), whereas 看起来 is a direct visual perception ("looks like").
显得 is a state or perceived impression, while 表现 refers to active behavioral conduct, performance, or demonstrative action.
显得 asserts that an impression is clearly manifested, while 好像 conveys subjective guesswork or speculative resemblance ("as if / like").
