Lacks the sun 日 on top of 显
Right side is 寺 instead of 旦+寸
Right side contains 十, 罒, 一, 心
Right side is 亍 without inner components

senses.definition_en: to clearly display or exhibit a certain outward feature, emotional atmosphere, or quality
senses.definition_es: manifestar de forma perceptible cierta cualidad, aspecto exterior o ambiente emocional
senses.example_phrase: 显得年轻 (look young / appear youthful)

example_sentences.hanzi: 穿上这套剪裁得体的深蓝色正装后，小李整个人立刻显得精神抖擞、干练沉稳。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuānshàng zhè tào jiǎncái-détǐ de shēnlánsè zhèngzhuāng hòu, Xiǎolǐ zhěng ge rén lìkè xiǎnde jīngshén-dǒusǒu, gànliàn chénwěn.
example_sentences.en: After putting on this well-tailored dark blue suit, Xiao Li immediately looked spirited, sharp, and composed.
example_sentences.es: Al enfundarse este traje azul marino impecable, Xiao Li cobró al instante un porte enérgico, resuelto y aplomado.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在大雪纷飞的寒冬腊月里，窗台上一盆悄然绽放的水仙花，让素朴的客厅显得格外生机盎然。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài dàxuě fēnfēi de hándōng làyuè lǐ, chuāngtái shàng yì pén qiǎorán zhànfàng de shuǐxiānhuā, ràng sùpǔ de kètīng xiǎnde géwài shēngjī-àngrán.
example_sentences.en: Amid swirling snows in midwinter, a potted narcissus blooming quietly on the windowsill made the simple living room seem extraordinarily vibrant.
example_sentences.es: En pleno rigor invernal entre nevadas, un narciso florecido en el alféizar infundió a la sobria sala una vitalidad primorosa.

idioms.meaning_en: display one's skill fully; make a grand show of prowess
obvious and evident; plain for all to see
show one's edge completely; display brilliance ostentatiously
bring out the best in each other; complement each other

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 顯. Ideogram showing dazzling sunlight 日 illuminating details clearly, making forms stand out and appear evident.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Bright rays of the blazing sun (日) illuminate everything below, revealing features prominently and visibly (显).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Los rayos del sol fulgurante (日) bañan cuanto alcanzan, haciendo resaltar y vislumbrar cualquier detalle (显).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient character showing footsteps 彳 reaching forward and a hand 寸 grasping valuable cowrie 旦, signifying acquisition or resultant degree.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Striding forward (彳) to grasp an insight (寸) reveals the acquired outward impression or resultant appearance (得).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dar pasos firmes (彳) hasta asir la verdad con la mano (寸) plasma el aspecto o grado manifiesto que se adquiere (得).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 雨后的青石板路被冲刷得一尘不染，两旁粉墙黛瓦的古民居倒映在清澈的水洼里，整座江南水乡小镇显得格外空灵幽寂，宛如一幅意境悠远的水墨画卷。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yǔ hòu de qīngshíbǎnlù bèi chōngshuā de yìchén-bùrǎn, liǎngpáng fěnqiáng-dàiwǎ de gǔmínjū dàoyìng zài qīngchè de shuǐwā lǐ, zhěng zuò Jiāngnán shuǐxiāng xiǎozhèn xiǎnde géwài kōnglíng-yōujì, wǎnrú yì fú yìjìng yōuyuǎn de shuǐmò huàjuàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Rain-washed stone paths lay spotless; whitewashed cottages reflected in clear puddles, making the Jiangnan water town look exceptionally serene and ethereal like a wash painting.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los adoquines tras la lluvia lucían limpios; los muros blancos se reflejaban en los charcos, haciendo que el pueblo fluvial pareciera sumamente apacible cual lienzo al aguada.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在喧嚣浮躁的时代，那些能够安于寂寞、潜心钻研的学者，往往显得有些特立独行。然而正是这种不随波逐流的坚守，构筑了人类精神文明最坚实高耸的灯塔。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xuānxiāo fúzào de shídài, nàxiē nénggòu ānyú jìmò, qiǎnxīn zuānyán de xuézhě, wǎngwǎng xiǎnde yǒuxiē tèlì-dúlì. Rán'ér zhèngshì zhèzhǒng bù suíbō-zhúliú de jiānshǒu, gòuzhù le rénlèi jīngshén wénmíng zuì jiānshí gāosǒng de dēngtǎ.
extended_reading_passages.en: In a restless age, scholars who embrace solitude to study often seem somewhat eccentric. Yet it is this steadfast resistance to fads that builds the towering lighthouses of human civilization.
extended_reading_passages.es: En tiempos de ligereza, los sabios que investigan en soledad suelen parecer singulares. Empero, esa recia constancia sin modas erige los faros más señeros de la cultura humana.

meanings_summary.en: especially; particularly; exceptionally; extraordinarily; beyond the ordinary
meanings_summary.es: especialmente; sumamente; en grado sumo; extraordinariamente; fuera de lo común

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Stepping beyond (外) the established framework and grid (格) elevates something to an extraordinary or exceptional degree (格外).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Salir fuera (外) del marco o cuadrícula reglamentaria (格) sitúa a algo en un grado extraordinario y especial (格外).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The compound 格外 literally means 'beyond the regular pattern / exceeding the frame' (在常规格子之外). In classical literature, it designated things surpassing the normal rule, hence serving as an intensifying adverb for striking phenomena.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'gé wài' (35-51). Lift steadily on 'gé' before dropping forcefully and cleanly on 'wài'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 格外 is an intensifying adverb emphasizing that an attribute noticeably exceeds ordinary standards or usual circumstances.

contrasts.analysis: 格外 is primarily an adverb modifying adjectives to mean "exceptionally / extraordinarily", whereas 特别 can also serve as an adjective meaning "special / unique" (特别的礼物).
格外 is common in both written and spoken Chinese, while 分外 is elevated, poetic, and literary (分外妖娆).
格外 implies a notable contrast with usual state or surroundings (今天格外冷 - colder than usual), while 非常 simply indicates an absolute high degree without contextual contrast.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has water radical 氵 on the left instead of wood 木
Has fire radical 火 on the left instead of wood 木
Has bottom line folding into 夂, distinct from 外
Has person radical 亻 instead of evening 夕
Has clothes radical 衤 instead of 夕

senses.definition_en: to an exceptional degree exceeding ordinary limits or standard expectations ("especially", "particularly")
senses.definition_es: en un grado extraordinario que sobrepasa la norma habitual o la expectativa común
senses.example_phrase: 格外引人注目 (especially eye-catching)

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过连夜暴风雪的洗礼，清晨推开房门，远处的苍翠松柏在白雪映衬下显得格外挺拔傲岸。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò liányè bàofēngxuě de xǐlǐ, qīngchén tuīkāi fángmén, yuǎnchù de cāngcuì sōngbǎi zài báixuě yìngchèn xià xiǎnde géwài tǐngbá ào'àn.
example_sentences.en: After overnight blizzards, opening the door at dawn revealed distant green pines standing exceptionally erect and proud against the snow.
example_sentences.es: Tras la ventisca nocturna, al abrir la puerta al alba los verdes pinos lejanos se erguían extraordinariamente airosos contra la blanca nieve.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在异国他乡漂泊多年的游子，每逢中秋佳节仰望夜空的一轮明月，心头总会涌起格外浓烈的思乡之情。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài yìguó tāxiāng piāobó duōnián de yóuzǐ, měi féng Zhōngqiū jiājié yǎngwàng yèkōng de yì lún míngyuè, xīntóu zǒng huì yǒngqǐ géwài nóngliè de sīxiāng zhī qíng.
example_sentences.en: A wanderer drifting abroad for years, gazing up at the bright Mid-Autumn moon, always feels a particularly intense surge of homesickness.
example_sentences.es: El emigrante errante que contempla la luna del Medio Otoño en tierras extrañas siente una nostalgia extraordinariamente honda y punzante por su tierra.

idioms.meaning_en: possess a distinctive style; uniquely fashioned
extraordinarily enchanting; strikingly gorgeous
draw public attention; conspicuous
out of the ordinary; different from the crowd

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where wood radical 木 denotes wooden lattice bars or framing posts, and 各 supplies sound.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Wooden timber poles (木) built into rigid square compartments and lattices (各) establish strict standards and frameworks (格).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Maderos torneados (木) ensamblados en cuadrículas simétricas (各) pautan el marco reglamentario y la norma fija (格).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph where evening twilight 夕 combines with divination crack 卜, denoting divining beyond ordinary daylight hours or boundaries.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Reading oracle cracks (卜) past evening twilight (夕) steps outside the daylight domain, signifying what lies beyond the boundary (外).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Interpretar presagios (卜) en el crepúsculo (夕) trasciende la jornada diurna, adentrándose más allá de las lindes ordinarias (外).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 深秋的清晨推开轩窗，庭院里的那株百年丹桂在微凉的晨风中暗香浮动。细碎的金黄色花朵点缀在浓绿枝叶间，在初升朝阳的斜照下显得格外明艳生动。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēnqiū de qīngchén tuīkāi xuānchuāng, tíngyuàn lǐ de nà zhū bǎinián dānguì zài wēiliáng de chénfēng zhōng ànxiāng fúdòng. Xìsuì de jīnhuángsè huāduǒ diǎnzhuì zài nónglǜ zhīyè jiān, zài chūshēng zhāoyáng de xiézhào xià xiǎnde géwài míngyàn shēngdòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Pushing open the lattice window in late autumn, the centenary osmanthus breathed subtle fragrance in the cool breeze. Tiny golden blossoms among leaves looked exceptionally vivid in morning sun.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al abrir la ventana en el alba otoñal, el viejo osmanto exhalaba un sutil aroma en la brisa. Sus menudas flores doradas entre el follaje verde lucían extraordinariamente vivaces bajo el sol naciente.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在重重困境与考验面前，人类所展现出的坚韧同理心与守望相助的奉献精神，往往显得格外耀眼。这种超越狭隘私利的崇高品质，正是照亮人类文明砥砺前行的不灭明灯。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài chóngchóng kùnjìng yǔ kǎoyàn miànqián, rénlèi suǒ zhǎnxiàn chū de jiānrèn tónglǐxīn yǔ shǒuwàng-xiāngzhù de fèngxiàn jīngshén, wǎngwǎng xiǎnde géwài yàoyǎn. Zhèzhǒng chāoyuè xiá'ài sīlì de chónggāo pǐnzhì, zhèngshì zhàoliàng rénlèi wénmíng dǐlì-qiánxíng de búmiè míngdēng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the face of trials and hardships, human empathy and mutual devotion shine with extraordinary brilliance. This noble spirit transcending narrow self-interest is an unquenchable beacon for civilization.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante las más duras pruebas, la recia empatía y la entrega desinteresada brillan con extraordinario fulgor. Esta nobleza que vence el egoísmo es el faro inextinguible de la marcha humana.

meanings_summary.en: scene; sight; spectacle; circumstance; picture
meanings_summary.es: escena; cuadro; panorama; espectáculo; circunstancia

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Genuine human emotion (情) cast against an illuminated panoramic scene (景) creates an evocative, memorable tableau (情景).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La emoción sentida en el corazón (情) proyectada sobre un paisaje iluminado (景) recrea una escena viva y conmovedora (情景).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese poetics (诗学: 王夫之), 'qíng' (情 - internal emotion) and 'jǐng' (景 - external scenery) are inseparable twins (情景交融). Great poetry does not depict cold scenery in isolation; rather, nature mirrors the human soul.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by dipping 3rd tone: 'qíng jǐng' (35-214). Ascend steadily on 'qíng', then swoop downward into the trough of 'jǐng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 情景 designates a specific, dynamic, and emotionally evocative visual scene or situational moment.

contrasts.analysis: 景色 refers strictly to static natural or physical landscapes (mountain views, gardens), whereas 情景 includes human actors, actions, and narrative atmosphere.
情况 refers to the factual, objective state of affairs, conditions, or data (经济情况), while 情景 focuses on the experiential, sensory visual scene.
情景 is intimate and emotive, while 场面 refers to macroscopic scale, spectacle, or formal commotion (宏大的战争场面, 婚礼场面).

senses.definition_en: a concrete scene, unfolding situation, or memorable sight involving people, actions, and atmosphere
senses.definition_es: escena o cuadro visual concreto y vívido que involucra personas, acciones y ambiente emotivo
senses.example_phrase: 感人情景 (touching scene / moving spectacle)

example_sentences.hanzi: 站台上母子依依惜别的感人情景，让周围不少步履匆匆的旅客都忍不住放慢脚步，为之动容。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhàntái shàng mǔzǐ yīyī-xībié de gǎnrén qíngjǐng, ràng zhōuwéi bùshǎo bùlǚ-cōngcōng de lǚkè dōu bǔrěnzhu fàngmàn jiǎobù, wéizhī dòngróng.
example_sentences.en: The touching scene of mother and son parting reluctantly on the platform prompted many hurried passengers to slow down, deeply moved.
example_sentences.es: La emotiva escena de madre e hijo despidiéndose en el andén conmovió a los viajeros presurosos, haciéndoles aminorar el paso con emoción.

example_sentences.hanzi: 每次故地重游漫步于曾经求学的母校林荫道上，当年与同窗好友秉烛夜读、畅谈理想的情景便历历在目。
example_sentences.pinyin: Měicì gùdì-chóngyóu mànbù yú céngjīng qiúxué de mǔxiào línyīndào shàng, dāngnián yǔ tóngchuāng hǎoyǒu bǐngzhú-yèdú, chàngtán lǐxiǎng de qíngjǐng biàn lìlì-zàimù.
example_sentences.en: Whenever I revisit my alma mater's shaded avenues, scenes of studying late and discussing ideals with classmates flash vividly before my eyes.
example_sentences.es: Al revisitar la arboleda de mi universidad, el recuerdo de las noches de estudio y confidencias juveniles con mis condiscípulos acude vívido a mi memoria.

blend of scenery and emotion; harmony of scene and feeling

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where heart radical 忄 indicates inner emotional state, and 青 supplies phonetic sound.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A vibrant young heart (忄) pulsating with verdant springtime life (青) embodies the full spectrum of feelings and situations (情).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un corazón sensible (忄) que vibra con la lozanía de la primavera verde (青) alberga el caudal de los sentimientos y estados del alma (情).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound combining blazing sun 日 illuminating high pavilions 京, depicting illuminated panoramic vistas.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Brilliant sunlight (日) cast over tall imperial towers (京) illuminates picturesque panoramas and dramatic scenes (景).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La viva luz del sol (日) iluminando las altas torres de la capital (京) descubre un imponente paisaje y un vasto panorama (景).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 黄昏的落日余晖洒在老屋门前，老爷爷坐在摇椅上给围坐在地毯上的孙儿们讲故事。炉火噼啪作响，这幅三代同堂、其乐融融的情景，深深定格在游子的心坎里。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Huánghūn de luòrì yúhuī sǎ zài lǎowū ménqián, lǎoyéye zuò zài yáoyǐ shàng gěi wéizuò zài dǐtǎn shàng de sūn'érmen jiǎng gùshì. Lúhuǒ pīpā zuòxiǎng, zhè fú sāndài-tóngtáng, qílè-róngróng de qíngjǐng, shēnshēn dìnggé zài yóuzǐ de xīnkǎn lǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Sunset rays bathed the porch as grandfather told stories to grandchildren on the rug. The hearth crackling, this joyful three-generation scene etched forever into the traveler's heart.
extended_reading_passages.es: El arrebol vespertino doraba el umbral mientras el abuelo narraba cuentos a los nietos en la alfombra. El crepitar del fuego y la dicha familiar grabaron una escena imborrable en el viajero.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在庄周生动风趣的寓言笔下，“朝三暮四”的猴子们由怒转喜的情景跃然纸上。这种寓哲理于诙谐生动情景的叙事艺术，跨越数千年光阴，依然具有直击心灵的启发力量。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài Zhuāng Zhōu shēngdòng fēngqù de yùyán bǐxià, "zhāosān-mùsì" de hóuzimen yóu nù zhuǎn xǐ de qíngjǐng yuèrán-zhǐshàng. Zhèzhǒng yù zhélǐ yú huīxié shēngdòng qíngjǐng de xùshì yìshù, kuàyuè shùqiān nián guāngyīn, yīrán jùyǒu zhíjī-xīnlíng de qǐfā lìliàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In Zhuangzi's witty fable, the scene of monkeys switching from rage to glee leaps from the page. Weaving philosophy into lively scenes retains potent revelatory power over millennia.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la pluma amena de Zhuangzi, la escena de los monos trocando el furor en alborozo cobra vida en el papel. El arte de cifrar verdades en cuadros vivaces conserva un vigor reflexivo intacto.

meanings_summary.en: ha (sound of laughter); haha; to exhale breath; to breathe out warm air
meanings_summary.es: ¡ja!; ¡jaja! (onomatopeya de risa franca); exhalar vaho; jadear

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An open mouth (口) combining harmoniously with others (合) to exhale merry laughter produces the joyous sound 'ha!' (哈).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Abrir la boca (口) en armoniosa comunión (合) para expulsar el aliento alegre emite la franca carcajada '¡ja!' (哈).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese traditional stage performance (戏曲: 京剧、相声), hearty laughter (哈哈大笑) and exaggerated yawns (打哈欠) are key expressive gestures. The character captures physiological breathwork and unrestrained comedic mirth.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-level 1st tone: 'hā' (55). Sound with open vocal resonance and clear, high sustained pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 哈 is an onomatopoeic exclamation of hearty open laughter or the action of blowing warm breath.

contrasts.analysis: 哈 expresses open laughter, amusement, or breathing warm air, while 嘿 is an attention-calling interjection ("hey!") or sinister snicker (嘿嘿冷笑).
哈 indicates hearty, loud, open-mouthed laughter (哈哈), whereas 呵 can denote gentle chuckles, ironic internet smirks (呵呵), or scolding (呵斥).
哈 is an onomatopoeia for laughter or exhaling, while 呀 is an expressive modal particle or cry of surprise ("ah! / oh!").

senses.definition_en: an onomatopoeic exclamation expressing hearty laughter, sudden realization, or amused delight ("ha!", "haha!")
senses.definition_es: interjección u onomatopeya que expresa risa franca, sorpresa gozosa o ironía ligera ("¡ja!", "¡jaja!")
senses.example_phrase: 哈哈大笑 (laugh heartily / roar with laughter)

senses.definition_en: to exhale breath forcefully through an open mouth, or blow warm moisture onto a surface (such as cold hands or foggy glass)
senses.definition_es: exhalar el aliento cálido por la boca abierta o echar vaho para calentarse las manos o limpiar cristales
senses.example_phrase: 哈了一口气 (blew a puff of warm air / exhaled a breath)

example_sentences.hanzi: 听完相声演员惟妙惟肖的滑稽模仿，台下的观众们再也忍不住了，齐声哈哈大笑起来。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tīngwán xiàngsheng yǎnyuán wéimiào-wéixiào de huájī mófǎng, táixià de guānzhòngmen zàiyě bǔrěnzhu le, qíshēng hāhā dàxiào qǐlái.
example_sentences.en: Hearing the crosstalk comedian's lifelike comical imitation, the audience couldn't hold it in any longer and burst into hearty laughter together.
example_sentences.es: Al escuchar la cómica e impecable parodia del comediante, los espectadores no pudieron contenerse y prorrumpieron en sonoras carcajadas al unísono.

example_sentences.hanzi: 寒风凛冽的清晨，守候在校门口的交警叔叔不时朝冻僵的双手哈出一口热气，搓了搓手继续坚守岗位。
example_sentences.pinyin: Hánfēng lǐnliè de qīngchén, shǒuhòu zài xiàoménkǒu de jiāojǐng shūshu bùshí cháo dòngjiāng de shuāngshǒu hāchū yì kǒu rèqì, cuō le cuō shǒu jìxù jiānshǒu gǎngwèi.
example_sentences.en: On a bitterly freezing morning, the traffic officer guarding the school gate puffed warm breath onto his numb hands and rubbed them, standing firm on duty.
example_sentences.es: En el alba gélida y ventosa, el agente apostado ante el colegio exhalaba vaho tibio sobre sus manos ateridas y las frotaba para seguir firme en su puesto.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic character where mouth radical 口 depicts vocal laughter, and 合 indicates harmonious blending of breath.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Opening one's mouth (口) wide with friendly companions (合) to exhale cheerful breath bursts into hearty laughter (哈).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Abrir la boca (口) de par en par en grata compañía (合) para soltar el aire produce una carcajada sonora (哈).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 冬日清晨的操场上呵气成霜，几个穿着厚棉袄的小伙伴哈着热气互相追逐嬉戏。谁不小心在雪地上滑了一跤，不但没哭，反倒爬起来拍拍雪花哈哈大笑。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dōngrì qīngchén de cāochǎng shàng hēqì-chéngshuāng, jǐ ge chuānzhe hòumián'ǎo de xiǎohuǒbàn hā zhe rèqì hùxiāng zhuīzhú xīxì. Shéi bùxiǎoxīn zài xuědì shàng huá le yì jiāo, búdàn méi kū, fǎndào pá qǐlái pāipai xuěhuā hāhā dàxiào.
extended_reading_passages.en: On the winter morning playground where breath turned to frost, kids bundled in coats chased each other puffing steam. Slipping on snow, none cried, but brushed off snow and roared with laughter.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el patio helado de la escuela, niños abrigados se perseguían echando vaho. Al resbalar sobre la nieve, lejos de llorar, se incorporaban sacudiéndose las solapas entre limpias carcajadas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 庄子以老夫赋芧的谐趣故事解构世俗执念，读者读至“众狙皆悦”处往往不禁莞尔而笑，哈的一声参透了万物齐一的玄妙机趣。笑声之中，浮躁的争名夺利顿时化为乌有。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhuāngzǐ yǐ lǎofū fùyù de xiéqù gùshì jiěgòu shìsú zhíniàn, dúzhě dú zhì "zhòngjū jiē yuè" chù wǎngwǎng bùjīn wǎn'ěr ér xiào, hā de yì shēng cāntòu le wànwù-qíyī de xuánmiào jīqù. Xiàoshēng zhīzhōng, fúzào de zhēngmíng-duólì dùnshí huàwéiwūyǒu.
extended_reading_passages.en: Zhuangzi's witty fable deconstructs earthly obsessions; reading "all monkeys rejoiced", one smiles and exhales a "ha!", grasping universal unity as trivial disputes dissolve into laughter.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con la fábula del anciano y las bellotas, Zhuangzi desbarata el apego terrenal; al leer que "todos los monos se alegraron", brota una carcajada lúcida que disuelve las vanas querellas.
